name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQResiduePeriod_eq_twoAdic_mul_exactPeriod
statement:
theorem nearestQResiduePeriod_eq_twoAdic_mul_exactPeriod
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQResiduePeriod q =
      2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
        nearestQExactPeriod q
proof:
:= by
  have hsLt :
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q < q :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_lt_self
      q
      (by omega)
  calc
    nearestQResiduePeriod q =
        2 ^ (q - 1) := by
      exact nearestQResiduePeriod_eq q
    _ =
        2 ^
          (nearestQTwoAdicOrder q +
            (q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q)) := by
      congr 1
      omega
    _ =
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
          2 ^ (q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q) := by
      rw [pow_add]
    _ =
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
          nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      rw [
        nearestQExactPeriod_eq_evenResiduePeriod_of_even_ge_six
          q hq hqEven
      ]
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_candidateMirror_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_candidateMirror_eq
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hr :
      r < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQResiduePeriod q - 1 - r) =
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q r
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hperiodLe :
      nearestQExactPeriod q ≤
        nearestQResiduePeriod q := by
    exact
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
        q hqPos).2.2
        (nearestQResiduePeriod q)
        (nearestQResiduePeriod_pos q)
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic
          q hqPos)
  have hrCandidate :
      r < nearestQResiduePeriod q :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hr hperiodLe
  have htwoPeriod :
      2 * nearestQResiduePeriod q =
        2 ^ q := by
    rw [nearestQResiduePeriod_eq]
    calc
      2 * 2 ^ (q - 1) =
          2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 := by
        ac_rfl
      _ =
          2 ^ ((q - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
      _ =
          2 ^ q := by
        congr 1
        omega
  have hxLt :
      2 * r + 1 < 2 ^ q := by
    omega
  have hbase :
      2 *
            (nearestQResiduePeriod q - 1 - r) +
          1 =
        2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1) := by
    omega
  have hsumZ :
      (((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1) : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q))) +
          (((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
            ZMod (2 ^ q))) =
        0 := by
    have hNat :
        (2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1)) +
            (2 * r + 1) =
          2 ^ q :=
      Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.le_of_lt hxLt)
    have hCast :=
      congrArg
        (fun z : Nat =>
          (z : ZMod (2 ^ q)))
        hNat
    simpa using hCast
  have hneg :
      (((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1) : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q))) =
        -(((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q))) := by
    have h :=
      congrArg
        (fun z : ZMod (2 ^ q) =>
          z -
            (((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
              ZMod (2 ^ q))))
        hsumZ
    simpa using h
  have hpowZ :
      ((((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1)) ^ q : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q))) =
        (((2 * r + 1) ^ q : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q)) := by
    have hpow :=
      congrArg
        (fun z : ZMod (2 ^ q) =>
          z ^ q)
        hneg
    calc
      ((((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1)) ^ q : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q))) =
        ((((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1) : Nat) :
            ZMod (2 ^ q))) ^ q) := by
          simp
      _ =
        (-(((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
            ZMod (2 ^ q)))) ^ q := by
          exact hpow
      _ =
        ((((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
            ZMod (2 ^ q))) ^ q) := by
          exact
            hqEven.neg_pow
              (((2 * r + 1 : Nat) :
                ZMod (2 ^ q)))
      _ =
        (((2 * r + 1) ^ q : Nat) :
          ZMod (2 ^ q)) := by
          simp
  have hmod :
      (2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1)) ^ q %
          2 ^ q =
        (2 * r + 1) ^ q %
          2 ^ q := by
    exact
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff'
        ((2 ^ q - (2 * r + 1)) ^ q)
        ((2 * r + 1) ^ q)
        (2 ^ q)).1
        hpowZ
  rw [
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod,
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod,
    hbase
  ]
  exact hmod

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_mirror_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_mirror_eq
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hr :
      r < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q r) =
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q r
proof:
:= by
  let K :=
    2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q
  let P :=
    nearestQExactPeriod q
  have hfactor :
      nearestQResiduePeriod q =
        K * P := by
    dsimp [K, P]
    exact
      nearestQResiduePeriod_eq_twoAdic_mul_exactPeriod
        q hq hqEven
  have hKPos :
      0 < K := by
    dsimp [K]
    positivity
  have hKSplit :
      K = 1 + (K - 1) := by
    omega
  have hperiodSplit :
      nearestQResiduePeriod q =
        P + (K - 1) * P := by
    calc
      nearestQResiduePeriod q =
          K * P :=
        hfactor
      _ =
          (1 + (K - 1)) * P := by
        rw [← hKSplit]
      _ =
          P + (K - 1) * P := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul]
        simp
  have hindex :
      nearestQResiduePeriod q - 1 - r =
        nearestQMirrorIndex q r +
          (K - 1) * P := by
    rw [hperiodSplit]
    dsimp [P]
    unfold nearestQMirrorIndex
    omega
  have hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        P := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
        q
        (by omega)).2.1
  have hmultiple :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        ((K - 1) * P) := by
    exact
      hperiod.nat_mul (K - 1)
  calc
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q r) =
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q r +
          (K - 1) * P) := by
      symm
      exact
        hmultiple
          (nearestQMirrorIndex q r)
    _ =
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQResiduePeriod q - 1 - r) := by
      congr 1
      exact hindex.symm
    _ =
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q r :=
      nearestQPowerResidueAt_candidateMirror_eq
        q r hq hqEven hr

      m ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :

          (nearestQExactPeriod q - m) +

          (m - 1)
proof:

  have hindex :

  calc

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_period_sub_eq_neg
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_period_sub_eq_neg
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (ht :
      t ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt q
        (nearestQExactPeriod q - t) =
      -nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hmain :
      ∀ u : Nat,
        u ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q →
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q
            (nearestQExactPeriod q - u) =
          -nearestQOmegaTildeAt q u := by
    intro u
    induction u with
    | zero =>
        intro _
        simp [
          nearestQOmegaTildeAt_exactPeriod_eq_zero
        ]
    | succ u ih =>
        intro huSucc
        have hu :
            u ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q := by
          omega
        have hih :
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt q
                (nearestQExactPeriod q - u) =
              -nearestQOmegaTildeAt q u :=
          ih hu
        have hback :
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt q
                (nearestQExactPeriod q - u) =
              nearestQOmegaTildeAt q
                  (nearestQExactPeriod q - (u + 1)) +
                nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q u := by
          have h :=
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt_period_sub_pred
              q
              (u + 1)
              hq
              hqEven
              (by omega)
              (by omega)
          simpa using h
        have hforward :
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (u + 1) =
              nearestQOmegaTildeAt q u +
                nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q u := by
          exact
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ
              q u hqPos
        linarith
  exact
    hmain t ht

@[simp]
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_two

    (hqEven : Even q) :

        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) ^ 2 =
      1
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hperiod :
      nearestQExactPeriod q =
        2 * nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_eq_two_mul_halfPeriod
      q hq hqEven
  have hpow :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          nearestQExactPeriod q =
        1 :=
    nearestQFourierRoot_pow_exactPeriod
      q hqPos
  calc
    (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) ^ 2 =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q * 2) := by
      rw [pow_mul]
    _ =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      congr 1
      omega
    _ = 1 := hpow

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierRoot_pow_halfPeriod_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierRoot_pow_halfPeriod_eq_neg_one
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q =
      (-1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
      nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q
  have hsq :
      z ^ 2 = 1 := by
    dsimp [z]
    exact
      nearestQFourierRoot_pow_halfPeriod_sq_eq_one
        q hq hqEven
  have hne :
      z ≠ 1 := by
    dsimp [z]
    exact
      nearestQFourierRoot_pow_halfPeriod_ne_one
        q hq hqEven
  have hfactor :
      (z - 1) * (z + 1) = 0 := by
    calc
      (z - 1) * (z + 1) =
          z ^ 2 - 1 := by
        ring
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [hsq]
        ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hleft | hright
  · exfalso
    apply hne
    exact
      sub_eq_zero.mp hleft
  · have hz :
        z - (-1 : ℂ) = 0 := by
      simpa using hright
    exact
      sub_eq_zero.mp hz

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNyquistPhase_mirror_eq_neg
statement:
theorem nearestQNyquistPhase_mirror_eq_neg
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hr :
      r < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    (-1 : ℂ) ^
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1) =
      -((-1 : ℂ) ^ (r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hperiod :
      nearestQExactPeriod q =
        2 * nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_eq_two_mul_halfPeriod
      q hq hqEven
  obtain ⟨k, hkEven | hkOdd⟩ :=
    Nat.even_or_odd' r
  · have hrOneOdd :
        Odd (r + 1) := by
      refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
      omega
    have hmirrorEven :
        Even
          (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1) := by
      refine
        ⟨nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q - k, ?_⟩
      unfold nearestQMirrorIndex
      omega
    rw [
      hmirrorEven.neg_one_pow,
      hrOneOdd.neg_one_pow
    ]
    ring
  · have hrOneEven :
        Even (r + 1) := by
      refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
      omega
    have hmirrorOdd :
        Odd
          (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1) := by
      refine
        ⟨nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q - k - 1, ?_⟩
      unfold nearestQMirrorIndex
      omega
    rw [
      hmirrorOdd.neg_one_pow,
      hrOneEven.neg_one_pow
    ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNyquistSummand_sum_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQNyquistSummand_sum_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (nearestQNyquistSummand q) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    nearestQExactPeriod q
  have hreindex :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (fun r =>
            nearestQNyquistSummand q
              (nearestQMirrorIndex q r)) := by
    refine
      Finset.sum_nbij'
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q)
        (nearestQMirrorIndex q)
        ?_
        ?_
        ?_
        ?_
        ?_
    · intro r hr
      apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
      exact
        nearestQMirrorIndex_lt_period
          q r hq
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
    · intro r hr
      apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
      exact
        nearestQMirrorIndex_lt_period
          q r hq
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
    · intro r hr
      exact
        nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
          q r hq
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
    · intro r hr
      exact
        nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
          q r hq
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
    · intro r hr
      rw [
        nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
          q r hq
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
      ]
  have hneg :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (fun r =>
            nearestQNyquistSummand q
              (nearestQMirrorIndex q r)) =
        -Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (fun r =>
            nearestQNyquistSummand q
              (nearestQMirrorIndex q r)) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (fun r =>
            -nearestQNyquistSummand q r) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r hr
        exact
          nearestQNyquistSummand_mirror_eq_neg
            q r hq hqEven
            (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
      _ =
        -Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hself :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) =
        -Finset.sum
          (Finset.range P)
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) :=
    hreindex.trans hneg
  let S : ℂ :=
    Finset.sum
      (Finset.range P)
      (nearestQNyquistSummand q)
  have hself' :
      S = -S := by
    exact hself
  have hadd :
      S + S = 0 := by
    calc
      S + S =
          S + (-S) := by
        exact
          congrArg
            (fun z : ℂ => S + z)
            hself'
      _ = 0 := by
        ring
  have htwo :
      (2 : ℂ) * S = 0 := by
    calc
      (2 : ℂ) * S =
          S + S := by
        ring
      _ = 0 :=
        hadd
  have htwoNe :
      (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num
  have hS :
      S = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left htwoNe
  exact hS

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_halfPeriod_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_halfPeriod_eq_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
        q
        (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
  have hsum :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
              ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q *
                  (r + 1))) =
        0 := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
              ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q *
                  (r + 1))) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (nearestQNyquistSummand q) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r _hr
        unfold nearestQNyquistSummand
        rw [
          nearestQNyquistInverseShiftedPhase_eq
            q r hq hqEven
        ]
      _ = 0 :=
        nearestQNyquistSummand_sum_zero
          q hq hqEven
  rw [hsum]
  ring

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_positive_sum

theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_positive_sum
    (q ell : Nat) :

proof:

  congr 1
  · simp
  · rw [map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierComplementInversePhase_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierComplementInversePhase_eq
    (q ell m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
        ((nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) * m) =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * m)
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierRoot q
  let P : Nat :=
    nearestQExactPeriod q
  have hzNe :
      z ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [z]
    exact nearestQFourierRoot_ne_zero q
  have hsum :
      P - ell + ell = P := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hellLe
  have hperiod :
      z ^ P = 1 := by
    dsimp [z, P]
    exact
      nearestQFourierRoot_pow_exactPeriod
        q hq
  have hprod :
      z ^ (P - ell) * z ^ ell = 1 := by
    calc
      z ^ (P - ell) * z ^ ell =
          z ^ ((P - ell) + ell) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
      _ = z ^ P := by
        rw [hsum]
      _ = 1 := hperiod
  have hcomp :
      z ^ (P - ell) =
        (z ^ ell)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      z ^ (P - ell) =
          z ^ (P - ell) *
            (z ^ ell * (z ^ ell)⁻¹) := by
        simp [hzNe]
      _ =
          (z ^ (P - ell) * z ^ ell) *
            (z ^ ell)⁻¹ := by
        ring
      _ =
          (z ^ ell)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hprod]
        simp
  calc
    z⁻¹ ^ ((P - ell) * m) =
        (z⁻¹ ^ (P - ell)) ^ m := by
      rw [pow_mul]
    _ =
        ((z ^ (P - ell))⁻¹) ^ m := by
      rw [inv_pow]
    _ =
        (((z ^ ell)⁻¹)⁻¹) ^ m := by
      rw [hcomp]
    _ =
        (z ^ ell) ^ m := by
      simp
    _ =
        z ^ (ell * m) := by
      rw [pow_mul]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_conj
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_conj
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
        q
        (nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) =
      (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
        q
        (nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) =
      (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
              ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                ((nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) *
                  (r + 1))) := by
      rfl
    _ =
      (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell * (r + 1))) := by
      apply congrArg
        (fun z : ℂ =>
          (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) * z)
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _hr
      congr 1
      exact
        nearestQFourierComplementInversePhase_eq
          q ell (r + 1) hq hellLe
    _ =
      (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell) := by
      symm
      exact
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_positive_sum
          q ell

statement:

    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :

        (ell * nearestQExactPeriod q) =

proof:

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierPositiveMirrorPhase_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierPositiveMirrorPhase_eq
    (q ell r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hr :
      r < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
        (ell * (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1)) =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
        ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
          (ell * (r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierRoot q
  let P : Nat :=
    nearestQExactPeriod q
  have hzNe :
      z ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [z]
    exact nearestQFourierRoot_ne_zero q
  have hmirror :
      nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1 =
        P - r := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact
      nearestQMirrorIndex_add_one_eq_period_sub
        q r hr
  have hperiod :
      z ^ (ell * P) = 1 := by
    dsimp [z, P]
    exact
      nearestQFourierRoot_pow_frequency_mul_period
        q ell hq
  have hrLe :
      r ≤ P := by
    dsimp [P]
    omega
  have hsub :
      P - r + r = P :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel hrLe
  have hsum :
      ell * (P - r) + ell * r =
        ell * P := by
    calc
      ell * (P - r) + ell * r =
          ell * ((P - r) + r) := by
        symm
        exact
          Nat.mul_add
            ell
            (P - r)
            r
      _ = ell * P := by
        rw [hsub]
  have hleft :
      z ^ (ell * (P - r)) =
        z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) := by
    calc
      z ^ (ell * (P - r)) =
          z ^ (ell * (P - r)) *
            (z ^ (ell * r) *
              (z ^ (ell * r))⁻¹) := by
        simp [hzNe]
      _ =
          (z ^ (ell * (P - r)) *
              z ^ (ell * r)) *
            (z ^ (ell * r))⁻¹ := by
        ring
      _ =
          z ^ (ell * P) *
            (z ^ (ell * r))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← pow_add, hsum]
      _ =
          (z ^ (ell * r))⁻¹ := by
        rw [hperiod]
        simp
      _ =
          z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) := by
        rw [inv_pow]
  have hright :
      z ^ ell *
          z⁻¹ ^ (ell * (r + 1)) =
        z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) := by
    rw [
      Nat.mul_add,
      Nat.mul_one,
      pow_add
    ]
    calc
      z ^ ell *
          (z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) *
            z⁻¹ ^ ell) =
        z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) *
          (z ^ ell * z⁻¹ ^ ell) := by
        ring
      _ =
        z⁻¹ ^ (ell * r) := by
        simp [hzNe]
  rw [hmirror]
  change
    z ^ (ell * (P - r)) =
      z ^ ell *
        z⁻¹ ^ (ell * (r + 1))
  exact
    hleft.trans hright.symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaPositiveFourierSum_mirror_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaPositiveFourierSum_mirror_eq
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (_hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun r =>
          (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (r + 1))) =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun r =>
          (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q
              (nearestQMirrorIndex q r) : ℂ) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell *
                (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  refine
    Finset.sum_nbij'
      (nearestQMirrorIndex q)
      (nearestQMirrorIndex q)
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
  · intro r hr
    apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
    exact
      nearestQMirrorIndex_lt_period
        q r hq
        (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
  · intro r hr
    apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
    exact
      nearestQMirrorIndex_lt_period
        q r hq
        (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
  · intro r hr
    exact
      nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
        q r hq
        (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
  · intro r hr
    exact
      nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
        q r hq
        (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
  · intro r hr
    rw [
      nearestQMirrorIndex_involutive
        q r hq
        (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
    ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_root_mul
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_root_mul
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell) =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_positive_sum
      q ell
  ]
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaPositiveFourierSum_mirror_eq
      q ell hq hqEven
  ]
  calc
    (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q
                (nearestQMirrorIndex q r) : ℂ) *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell *
                  (nearestQMirrorIndex q r + 1))) =
      (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
              ((nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                  (ell * (r + 1)))) := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r hr
      have hrLt :
          r < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
        Finset.mem_range.mp hr
      rw [
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_mirror_eq
          q r hq hqEven hrLt,
        nearestQFourierPositiveMirrorPhase_eq
          q ell r hqPos hrLt
      ]
      ring
    _ =
      (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
        (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                  (ell * (r + 1)))) := by
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
        ((1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                  (ell * (r + 1)))) := by
      ring
    _ =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell := by
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_root_mul
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_root_mul
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
        q
        (nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) =
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell *
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_conj
      q ell hqPos hellLe,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_root_mul
      q ell hq hqEven
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff_conj_eq_self
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff_conj_eq_self
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell) =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff
  rw [
    map_mul,
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase_conj_eq_inv,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_conj_eq_root_mul
      q ell hq hqEven,
    ← nearestQFourierHalfPhase_sq_eq
      q ell
  ]
  let h :=
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell
  let a :=
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell
  have hhNe :
      h ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_ne_zero
        q ell
  change
    h⁻¹ * (h ^ 2 * a) =
      h * a
  calc
    h⁻¹ * (h ^ 2 * a) =
        (h⁻¹ * h) * (h * a) := by
      ring
    _ = h * a := by
      simp [hhNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff_coe_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff_coe_eq
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell
proof:
:= by
  have hconj :
      (starRingEnd ℂ)
          (nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell) =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell :=
    nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff_conj_eq_self
      q ell hq hqEven
  have him :
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell).im =
        0 := by
    have h :=
      congrArg Complex.im hconj
    simp at h
    linarith
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp [nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff]
  · simp [
      nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff,
      him
    ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_eq_halfPhase_inv_mul_realCoeff
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_eq_halfPhase_inv_mul_realCoeff
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell =
      (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
        ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe :
      ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff q ell :=
    nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff_coe_eq
      q ell hq hqEven
  unfold
    nearestQCenteredOmegaPhaseCorrectedCoeff
      at hcoe
  have hhNe :
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell ≠ 0 :=
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase_ne_zero
      q ell
  calc
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell =
        (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
          (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
            nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell) := by
      simp [hhNe]
    _ =
        (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
          ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← hcoe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_halfPhase_mul_realCoeff
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_halfPhase_mul_realCoeff
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
        q
        (nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) =
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
        ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_root_mul
      q ell hq hqEven hellLe,
    ← nearestQFourierHalfPhase_sq_eq
      q ell,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_eq_halfPhase_inv_mul_realCoeff
      q ell hq hqEven
  ]
  let h : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell
  let b : ℂ :=
    ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hhNe :
      h ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_ne_zero
        q ell
  change
    h ^ 2 * (h⁻¹ * b) =
      h * b
  calc
    h ^ 2 * (h⁻¹ * b) =
        (h⁻¹ * h) * (h * b) := by
      ring
    _ = h * b := by
      simp [hhNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierComplementPositivePhase_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierComplementPositivePhase_eq
    (q ell m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
        ((nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) * m) =
      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
        (ell * m)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    congrArg
      (starRingEnd ℂ)
      (nearestQFourierComplementInversePhase_eq
        q ell m hq hellLe)
  simpa only [

    nearestQFourierRoot_inv_conj_eq,
    nearestQFourierRoot_conj_eq_inv
  ] using h

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_halfPhase
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_halfPhase
    (q ell t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm q ell t =
      ((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
          ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * (t + 1)) +
      (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
          ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
          (ell * (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_eq_halfPhase_inv_mul_realCoeff
      q ell hq hqEven,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_complement_eq_halfPhase_mul_realCoeff
      q ell hq hqEven hellLe,
    nearestQFourierComplementPositivePhase_eq
      q ell (t + 1) hqPos hellLe
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierHalfPhase_inv_mul_positivePhase_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierHalfPhase_inv_mul_positivePhase_eq
    (q ell t : Nat) :
    (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * (t + 1)) =
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell ^
        (2 * t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell
  let z : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierRoot q
  have hhNe :
      h ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_ne_zero
        q ell
  have hsq :
      h ^ 2 = z ^ ell := by
    dsimp [h, z]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_sq_eq
        q ell
  have hexp :
      2 * (t + 1) =
        (2 * t + 1) + 1 := by
    omega
  calc
    h⁻¹ * z ^ (ell * (t + 1)) =
        h⁻¹ * (z ^ ell) ^ (t + 1) := by
      rw [pow_mul]
    _ =
        h⁻¹ * (h ^ 2) ^ (t + 1) := by
      rw [← hsq]
    _ =
        h⁻¹ * h ^ (2 * (t + 1)) := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
    _ =
        h⁻¹ * h ^ ((2 * t + 1) + 1) := by
      rw [hexp]
    _ =
        h⁻¹ *
          (h ^ (2 * t + 1) * h) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
    _ =
        (h⁻¹ * h) *
          h ^ (2 * t + 1) := by
      ring
    _ =
        h ^ (2 * t + 1) := by
      simp [hhNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierHalfPhase_mul_inversePositivePhase_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierHalfPhase_mul_inversePositivePhase_eq
    (q ell t : Nat) :
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
        ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
          (ell * (t + 1)) =
      ((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹) ^
        (2 * t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell
  let z : ℂ :=
    nearestQFourierRoot q
  have hhNe :
      h ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_ne_zero
        q ell
  have hsq :
      h ^ 2 = z ^ ell := by
    dsimp [h, z]
    exact
      nearestQFourierHalfPhase_sq_eq
        q ell
  have hsqInv :
      h⁻¹ ^ 2 = z⁻¹ ^ ell := by
    calc
      h⁻¹ ^ 2 =
          (h ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_pow]
      _ =
          (z ^ ell)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hsq]
      _ =
          z⁻¹ ^ ell := by
        rw [inv_pow]
  have hexp :
      2 * (t + 1) =
        (2 * t + 1) + 1 := by
    omega
  calc
    h * z⁻¹ ^ (ell * (t + 1)) =
        h * (z⁻¹ ^ ell) ^ (t + 1) := by
      rw [pow_mul]
    _ =
        h * (h⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ (t + 1) := by
      rw [← hsqInv]
    _ =
        h * h⁻¹ ^ (2 * (t + 1)) := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
    _ =
        h * h⁻¹ ^ ((2 * t + 1) + 1) := by
      rw [hexp]
    _ =
        h *
          (h⁻¹ ^ (2 * t + 1) * h⁻¹) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
    _ =
        (h * h⁻¹) *
          h⁻¹ ^ (2 * t + 1) := by
      ring
    _ =
        h⁻¹ ^ (2 * t + 1) := by
      simp [hhNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_realCoeff_mul_halfPhaseSum
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_realCoeff_mul_halfPhaseSum
    (q ell t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm q ell t =
      ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell ^
            (2 * t + 1) +
          ((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹) ^
            (2 * t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_halfPhase
      q ell t hq hqEven hellLe
  ]
  calc
    ((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
          ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^
            (ell * (t + 1)) +
        (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
          ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
            (ell * (t + 1)) =
      ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹ *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) +
          (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell *
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
              (ell * (t + 1)))) := by
      ring
    _ =
      ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealCoeff q ell : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell ^
            (2 * t + 1) +
          ((nearestQFourierHalfPhase q ell)⁻¹) ^
            (2 * t + 1)) := by
      rw [
        nearestQFourierHalfPhase_inv_mul_positivePhase_eq,
        nearestQFourierHalfPhase_mul_inversePositivePhase_eq
      ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_realCoeff_mul_cosineKernel
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_realCoeff_mul_cosineKernel
    (q ell t : Nat)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm_coe_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm_coe_eq
    (q ell t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    ((nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm
        q ell t : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm
        q ell t
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm
  symm
  exact
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm_eq_realCos
      q ell t hq hqEven hellLe

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNonzeroFourierFrequencies_eq_lower_mid_upper
statement:
theorem nearestQNonzeroFourierFrequencies_eq_lower_mid_upper
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.Ico
        1
        (nearestQExactPeriod q) =
      nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q ∪
        (({nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q} : Finset Nat) ∪
          nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies q)
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hperiodPos :
      0 < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hqPos
  have hperiod :
      nearestQExactPeriod q =
        2 * nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_eq_two_mul_halfPeriod
      q hq hqEven
  have hhalfPos :
      0 < nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q := by
    rw [hperiod] at hperiodPos
    omega
  ext ell
  simp only [
    nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies,
    nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies,
    Finset.mem_Ico,
    Finset.mem_Ioo,
    Finset.mem_union,
    Finset.mem_singleton
  ]
  rw [hperiod]
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFrequencyComplement_mem_upper
statement:

    (q ell : Nat)

proof:

statement:

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQUpperFourierSum_eq_complementLowerSum
statement:
theorem nearestQUpperFourierSum_eq_complementLowerSum
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) =
      Finset.sum
        (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff
              q
              (nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              ((nearestQExactPeriod q - ell) *
                (t + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  refine
    Finset.sum_nbij'
      (fun ell =>
        nearestQExactPeriod q - ell)
      (fun ell =>
        nearestQExactPeriod q - ell)
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
      ?_
  · intro ell hell
    exact
      nearestQFrequencyComplement_mem_lower
        q ell hq hqEven hell
  · intro ell hell
    exact
      nearestQFrequencyComplement_mem_upper
        q ell hq hqEven hell
  · intro ell hell
    have hellBounds :
        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q < ell ∧
          ell < nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies,
        Finset.mem_Ioo
      ] using hell
    exact
      nearestQFrequencyComplement_involutive
        q ell hellBounds.2
  · intro ell hell
    have hperiod :
        nearestQExactPeriod q =
          2 * nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
      nearestQExactPeriod_eq_two_mul_halfPeriod
        q hq hqEven
    have hellBounds :
        1 ≤ ell ∧
          ell < nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies,
        Finset.mem_Ico
      ] using hell
    have hellPeriod :
        ell < nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      rw [hperiod]
      omega
    exact
      nearestQFrequencyComplement_involutive
        q ell hellPeriod
  · intro ell hell
    have hellBounds :
        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q < ell ∧
          ell < nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies,
        Finset.mem_Ioo
      ] using hell
    rw [
      nearestQFrequencyComplement_involutive
        q ell hellBounds.2
    ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQLower_add_upperFourierSum_eq_pairSum
statement:
theorem nearestQLower_add_upperFourierSum_eq_pairSum
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) +
      Finset.sum
        (nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) =
      Finset.sum
        (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm
            q ell t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQUpperFourierSum_eq_complementLowerSum
      q t hq hqEven
  ]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ell _hell
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_pairSum
statement:
theorem nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_pairSum
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Ico
          1
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) =
      Finset.sum
        (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierPairTerm
            q ell t)
proof:
:= by
  have hLowerDisj :
      Disjoint
        (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
        (({nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q} : Finset Nat) ∪
          nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies q) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro ell hLower hRest
    have hLowerBounds :
        1 ≤ ell ∧
          ell < nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies,
        Finset.mem_Ico
      ] using hLower
    simp only [
      Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_singleton
    ] at hRest
    rcases hRest with hMid | hUpper
    · omega
    · have hUpperBounds :
          nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q < ell ∧
            ell < nearestQExactPeriod q := by
        simpa only [
          nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies,
          Finset.mem_Ioo
        ] using hUpper
      omega
  have hMidUpperDisj :
      Disjoint
        ({nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q} : Finset Nat)
        (nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies q) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro ell hMid hUpper
    have hMidEq :
        ell = nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        Finset.mem_singleton
      ] using hMid
    have hUpperBounds :
        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q < ell ∧
          ell < nearestQExactPeriod q := by
      simpa only [
        nearestQUpperFourierFrequencies,
        Finset.mem_Ioo
      ] using hUpper
    omega
  rw [
    nearestQNonzeroFourierFrequencies_eq_lower_mid_upper
      q hq hqEven,
    Finset.sum_union hLowerDisj,
    Finset.sum_union hMidUpperDisj,
    Finset.sum_singleton,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_halfPeriod_eq_zero
      q hq hqEven
  ]
  simpa only [
    zero_mul,
    zero_add
  ] using
    nearestQLower_add_upperFourierSum_eq_pairSum
      q t hq hqEven

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_realCosineSum
statement:
theorem nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_realCosineSum
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Ico
          1
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^
              (ell * (t + 1))) =
      ((Finset.sum
          (nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies q)
          (fun ell =>
            nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm
              q ell t) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_pairSum
      q t hq hqEven
  ]
  push_cast
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ell hell
  have hellBounds :
      1 ≤ ell ∧
        ell < nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q := by
    simpa only [
      nearestQLowerFourierFrequencies,
      Finset.mem_Ico
    ] using hell
  have hperiod :
      nearestQExactPeriod q =
        2 * nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_eq_two_mul_halfPeriod
      q hq hqEven
  have hellLe :
      ell ≤ nearestQExactPeriod q := by
    rw [hperiod]
    omega
  symm
  exact
    nearestQCenteredOmegaRealFourierPairTerm_coe_eq
      q ell t hq hqEven hellLe

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNonzeroFourierSum_eq_realCosineSeries
statement:

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_eq_realCosineSeries
statement:

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_coe_eq_realCosineSeries
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_coe_eq_realCosineSeries

    (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) =

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_coe_eq_finiteCosineExpansion
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_coe_eq_finiteCosineExpansion
    (q t : Nat)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThreshold_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedThreshold_nonneg
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    0 ≤ shiftedThreshold q a b m
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedThreshold
  have hbRat : (0 : Rat) < (b : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have hamRat :
      (a : Rat) ≤ (b : Rat) * (m : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast ham
  have hbase :
      0 ≤ (m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) := by
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hbRat).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hamRat
  apply Int.ceil_nonneg
  exact pow_nonneg hbase q

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_cast
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_cast
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    (shiftedThresholdNat q a b m : Int) =
      shiftedThreshold q a b m
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedThresholdNat
  rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (shiftedThreshold_nonneg q a b m hb ham)]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
    (q a b m k : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    shiftedThresholdNat q a b m ≤ k ↔
      (((m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hInt :
        shiftedThreshold q a b m ≤ (k : Int) := by
      rw [← shiftedThresholdNat_cast q a b m hb ham]
      exact_mod_cast h
    simpa [shiftedThreshold] using (Int.ceil_le.mp hInt)
  · intro h
    have hInt :
        shiftedThreshold q a b m ≤ (k : Int) := by
      unfold shiftedThreshold
      exact Int.ceil_le.mpr h
    rw [← shiftedThresholdNat_cast q a b m hb ham] at hInt
    exact_mod_cast hInt

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_succ
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_succ
    (q a b n t : Nat) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n (t + 1) =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t +
        (n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedInversionSum, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_pos
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_pos
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    0 < shiftedThresholdNat q a b m
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hm
  have ham : a ≤ b * m := by
    calc
      a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
      _ = b * 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ b * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hm1
  have hbRat : (0 : Rat) < (b : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have haRat : (a : Rat) < (b : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast ha
  have hmRat : (1 : Rat) ≤ (m : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hm1
  have hbase :
      (0 : Rat) <
        (m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) := by
    rw [sub_pos]
    have hdiv_lt_one :
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) < 1 := by
      exact (div_lt_one hbRat).2 haRat
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hdiv_lt_one hmRat
  have hpow :
      (0 : Rat) <
        (((m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) := by
    exact pow_pos hbase q
  have hInt :
      (0 : Int) < shiftedThreshold q a b m := by
    unfold shiftedThreshold
    exact Int.ceil_pos.mpr hpow
  rw [← shiftedThresholdNat_cast q a b m hb ham] at hInt
  exact_mod_cast hInt

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdCount_eq
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdCount_eq
    (q a b n m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    shiftedThresholdCount q a b n m =
      n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b m
proof:
:= by
  have hpos :
      1 ≤ shiftedThresholdNat q a b m :=
    shiftedThresholdNat_pos q a b m hb ha hm
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k => shiftedThresholdNat q a b m ≤ k) =
        Finset.Icc (shiftedThresholdNat q a b m) n := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hk
      exact ⟨hk.2, hk.1.2⟩
    · intro hk
      exact ⟨⟨le_trans hpos hk.1, hk.2⟩, hk.1⟩
  unfold shiftedThresholdCount
  rw [hfilter]
  exact Nat.card_Icc (shiftedThresholdNat q a b m) n

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedCountSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem shiftedCountSum_eq_inversionSum
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedCountSum shiftedInversionSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  exact shiftedThresholdCount_eq
    q a b n (m + 1) hb ha (Nat.succ_pos m)

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_shiftedIncidencePairs_iff
statement:
theorem mem_shiftedIncidencePairs_iff
    (q a b n t m k : Nat) :
    (m, k) ∈ shiftedIncidencePairs q a b n t ↔
      m < t ∧
      1 ≤ k ∧
      k ≤ n ∧
      shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedIncidencePairs, and_assoc]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdCount_eq_sum_indicator
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdCount_eq_sum_indicator
    (q a b n m : Nat) :
    shiftedThresholdCount q a b n (m + 1) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k =>
        shiftedIncidenceIndicator q a b m k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold shiftedThresholdCount shiftedIncidenceIndicator
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCount_eq_sum_indicator
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCount_eq_sum_indicator
    (q a b k t : Nat) :
    shiftedLevelCount q a b k t =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedIncidenceIndicator q a b m k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold shiftedLevelCount shiftedIncidenceIndicator
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedCountSum_eq_levelCountSum
statement:
theorem shiftedCountSum_eq_levelCountSum
    (q a b n t : Nat) :
    shiftedCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedLevelCountSum q a b n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedCountSum shiftedLevelCountSum
  simp_rw [shiftedThresholdCount_eq_sum_indicator]
  simp_rw [shiftedLevelCount_eq_sum_indicator]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCountSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCountSum_eq_inversionSum
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedLevelCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedLevelCountSum q a b n t =
        shiftedCountSum q a b n t :=
      (shiftedCountSum_eq_levelCountSum q a b n t).symm
    _ = shiftedInversionSum q a b n t :=
      shiftedCountSum_eq_inversionSum q a b n t hb ha

name: RoundedRootSums.le_sqrt_iff_sq_le
statement:
theorem le_sqrt_iff_sq_le (m k : Nat) :
    m ≤ Nat.sqrt k ↔ m ^ 2 ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pow_two] using
    (Nat.le_sqrt : m ≤ Nat.sqrt k ↔ m * m ≤ k)

name: RoundedRootSums.reciprocalCount_formula
statement:
theorem reciprocalCount_formula
    (n m : Nat)
    (h : m ^ 2 ≤ n) :
    reciprocalCount n m = n - m ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalCount
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.card_Icc_one_sqrt
statement:
theorem card_Icc_one_sqrt (k : Nat) :
    (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.sqrt k)).card = Nat.sqrt k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.sq_le_implies_le_rootIndex
statement:
theorem sq_le_implies_le_rootIndex
    (m k n : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hm : m ^ 2 ≤ k) :
    m ≤ rootIndex n
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootIndex
  apply (le_sqrt_iff_sq_le m n).2
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_as_filtered_card
statement:
theorem sqrt_as_filtered_card
    (k n : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.sqrt k =
      ((Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
        (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
          (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k) =
        Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.sqrt k) := by
    ext m
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hm
      exact ⟨hm.1.1, (le_sqrt_iff_sq_le m k).2 hm.2⟩
    · intro hm
      have hsq : m ^ 2 ≤ k :=
        (le_sqrt_iff_sq_le m k).1 hm.2
      exact
        ⟨⟨hm.1,
            sq_le_implies_le_rootIndex m k n hk hsq⟩,
          hsq⟩
  rw [hfilter, card_Icc_one_sqrt]

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_as_filtered_cards
statement:
theorem rootSum_as_filtered_cards (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k =>
        ((Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
          (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k + 1)).card)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hk' : k + 1 ≤ n := by
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  exact sqrt_as_filtered_card (k + 1) n hk'

        (fun m => reciprocalCount n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSum_as_filtered_cards]
  rw [← admissiblePairs_card_by_k]
  exact admissiblePairs_card_by_reciprocalCount n

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic_iff_omega
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic_iff_omega
    (q d : Nat) :
    Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q) d ↔
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQOmegaAt q) d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hResidue r
    unfold nearestQOmegaAt
    rw [hResidue r]
  · intro hOmega r
    have h :=
      hOmega r
    unfold nearestQOmegaAt at h
    have hden :
        ((2 : Rat) ^ q) ≠ 0 := by
      positivity
    have hcast :
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q (r + d) : Rat) =
          (nearestQPowerResidueAt q r : Rat) := by
      field_simp [hden] at h
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast

  · rintro ⟨hPpos, hPperiod, hPmin⟩

        q P).1 hPperiod,
      ?_
    ⟩
    intro d hdpos hdperiod
    exact hPmin d hdpos
      ((nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic_iff_omega
        q d).2 hdperiod)
  · rintro ⟨hPpos, hPperiod, hPmin⟩
    refine ⟨
      hPpos,
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic_iff_omega
        q P).2 hPperiod,

        q d).1 hdperiod)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod
    (q r : Nat) :

      (2 * r + 1) ^ q % 2 ^ q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQPowerResidueAt
  unfold shiftedPowerResidue
  unfold shiftedPowerNumerator
  unfold shiftedPowerDenominator
  have hbase :
      2 * (r + 1) - 1 = 2 * r + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hbase]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod]
  have hlt :
      1 < 2 ^ q := by
    exact Nat.one_lt_two_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  simpa using
    (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_modEq_one
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_modEq_one
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q) d) :
    Nat.ModEq
      (2 ^ q)
      ((2 * d + 1) ^ q)
      1
proof:
:= by
  have hAtZero :
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q d =
        nearestQPowerResidueAt q 0 := by
    simpa using hperiod 0
  have hResidue :
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q d = 1 := by
    calc
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q d =
          nearestQPowerResidueAt q 0 :=
        hAtZero
      _ = 1 :=
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_zero q hq
  rw [nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod] at hResidue
  change
    ((2 * d + 1) ^ q) % (2 ^ q) =
      1 % (2 ^ q)
  have hlt :
      1 < 2 ^ q := by
    exact Nat.one_lt_two_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
  exact hResidue

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_pow_dvd_sub_one
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_pow_dvd_sub_one
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q) d) :
    2 ^ q ∣ (2 * d + 1) ^ q - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmod :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_modEq_one
      q d hq hperiod
  have hle :
      1 ≤ (2 * d + 1) ^ q := by
    exact Nat.one_le_pow' q (2 * d)
  exact
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hle).1 hmod.symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_odd_period_implies_pow_dvd_two_mul
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_odd_period_implies_pow_dvd_two_mul
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqOdd : Odd q)
    (hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q) d) :
    2 ^ q ∣ 2 * d
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :
      2 ^ q ∣ (2 * d + 1) ^ q - 1 :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_period_implies_pow_dvd_sub_one
      q d hq hperiod
  have hproduct :
      2 ^ q ∣ nearestQGeomSum q d * (2 * d) := by
    rw [nearestQGeomSum_mul_two_mul]
    exact hpow
  have hcoprimeTwo :
      Nat.Coprime 2 (nearestQGeomSum q d) := by
    exact
      (Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2
        (nearestQGeomSum_not_two_dvd q d hqOdd)
  have hcoprimePow :
      Nat.Coprime (2 ^ q) (nearestQGeomSum q d) :=
    hcoprimeTwo.pow_left q
  exact hcoprimePow.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hproduct

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQResiduePeriod_dvd_of_odd_period
statement:
theorem nearestQResiduePeriod_dvd_of_odd_period
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqOdd : Odd q)
    (hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q) d) :
    nearestQResiduePeriod q ∣ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestQResiduePeriod_eq]
  have htwo :
      2 ^ q ∣ 2 * d :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_odd_period_implies_pow_dvd_two_mul
      q d hq hqOdd hperiod
  have hqSplit :
      (q - 1) + 1 = q := by
    omega
  have hpowEq :
      2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ q := by
    calc
      2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 =
          2 ^ ((q - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
      _ = 2 ^ q := by
        rw [hqSplit]
  have hcancel :
      2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 ∣ d * 2 := by
    rw [hpowEq]
    simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using htwo
  exact Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right
    (k := 2)
    (by decide)
    hcancel

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod_of_odd
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod_of_odd
    (q : Nat)

      (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)

    nearestQPowerResidueAt_periodic q hq,

  ⟩

    (nearestQResiduePeriod_dvd_of_odd_period
      q d hq hqOdd hdperiod)

      q (nearestQResiduePeriod q)).1

        q hq hqOdd)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_two
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_two
    (r : Nat) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt 2 r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod]
  have hpow :
      (2 * r + 1) ^ 2 =
        4 * (r ^ 2 + r) + 1 := by
    ring
  rw [hpow]
  norm_num [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_four
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_four
    (r : Nat) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt 4 r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod]
  obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ :=
    Nat.even_or_odd' r
  · rw [hk]
    have hpow :
        (2 * (2 * k) + 1) ^ 4 =
          16 *
              (16 * k ^ 4 +
                16 * k ^ 3 +
                6 * k ^ 2 +
                k) +
            1 := by
      ring
    rw [hpow]
    norm_num [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod]
  · rw [hk]
    have hpow :
        (2 * (2 * k + 1) + 1) ^ 4 =
          16 *
              (16 * k ^ 4 +
                48 * k ^ 3 +
                54 * k ^ 2 +
                27 * k +
                5) +
            1 := by
      ring
    rw [hpow]
    norm_num [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod]

      (p := 2)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart
statement:
theorem nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart
    (q : Nat) :
    2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
        nearestQOddPart q =
      q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQOddPart
  exact Nat.mul_div_cancel'
    (nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pow_dvd q)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOddPart_not_two_dvd
statement:
theorem nearestQOddPart_not_two_dvd
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    ¬2 ∣ nearestQOddPart q
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiv
  apply
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_next_pow_not_dvd
      q hq
  rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  calc
    q =
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
          nearestQOddPart q := by
      symm
      exact nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart q
    _ =
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q *
          (2 * k) := by
      rw [hk]
    _ =
        (2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q * 2) *
          k := by
      ac_rfl
    _ =
        2 ^ (nearestQTwoAdicOrder q + 1) *
          k := by
      rw [pow_succ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOddPart_pos
statement:
theorem nearestQOddPart_pos
    (q : Nat)

proof:
:= by
  by_contra hpos
  have hzero :
      nearestQOddPart q = 0 := by
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hpos
  have hdecomp :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart q

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ :=
    Nat.even_or_odd' (nearestQOddPart q)
  · exfalso
    apply nearestQOddPart_not_two_dvd q hq
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩

  · exact ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQTwoAdicOrder_lt_self
statement:
theorem nearestQTwoAdicOrder_lt_self
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder q < q
proof:
:= by
  have hpowDvd :
      2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ∣ q :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pow_dvd q
  have hpowLe :
      2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ≤ q :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd hq hpowDvd
  have horderLtPow :
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q <
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q := by
    generalize
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q = s
    induction s with
    | zero =>
        norm_num
    | succ s ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        omega
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le horderLtPow hpowLe

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pos_of_even
statement:
theorem nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pos_of_even
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    0 < nearestQTwoAdicOrder q
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hpos
  have hzero :
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q = 0 := by
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hpos
  have hnot :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_next_pow_not_dvd
      q hq
  rw [hzero] at hnot
  norm_num at hnot
  rcases hqEven with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [hk] at hnot
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQTwoAdicOrder_add_two_le_of_even_ge_six
statement:
theorem nearestQTwoAdicOrder_add_two_le_of_even_ge_six
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder q + 2 ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by
    omega
  have hsPos :
      0 < nearestQTwoAdicOrder q :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pos_of_even
      q hqPos hqEven
  by_cases hsOne :
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q = 1
  · omega
  · have hsTwo :
        2 ≤ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q := by
      omega
    have hpowDvd :
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ∣ q :=
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pow_dvd q
    have hpowLe :
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ≤ q :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd hqPos hpowDvd
    have haux :
        ∀ s : Nat,
          2 ≤ s →
          s + 2 ≤ 2 ^ s := by
      intro s hs
      induction s with
      | zero =>
          omega
      | succ s ih =>
          by_cases hsOne' : s = 1
          · subst s
            norm_num
          · have hsTwo' : 2 ≤ s := by
              omega
            have hih := ih hsTwo'
            rw [pow_succ]
            omega
    exact le_trans
      (haux
        (nearestQTwoAdicOrder q)
        hsTwo)
      hpowLe

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQEvenResidueExponent_pos
statement:
theorem nearestQEvenResidueExponent_pos
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFirstBinomialTerm_dvd
statement:
theorem nearestQFirstBinomialTerm_dvd
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    2 ^ q ∣
      q * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1) *
        nearestQEvenShift q
proof:
:= by
  let s :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder q
  let u :=
    nearestQOddPart q
  change
    2 ^ q ∣
      q * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1) *
        2 ^ (q - s)
  have hsLe :
      s ≤ q := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt
      (nearestQTwoAdicOrder_lt_self q hq)
  have hdecomp :
      2 ^ s * u = q := by
    simpa [s, u] using
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart q
  have hpow :
      2 ^ s * 2 ^ (q - s) = 2 ^ q := by
    calc
      2 ^ s * 2 ^ (q - s) =
          2 ^ (s + (q - s)) := by
        rw [pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ q := by
        rw [show s + (q - s) = q by omega]
  refine
    ⟨u * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1), ?_⟩
  calc
    q * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1) *
          2 ^ (q - s) =
        (2 ^ s * u) *
          (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1) *
          2 ^ (q - s) := by
      rw [hdecomp]
    _ =
        (2 ^ s * 2 ^ (q - s)) *
          (u * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1)) := by
      ac_rfl
    _ =
        2 ^ q *
          (u * (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - 1)) := by
      rw [hpow]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQTwoAdicOrder_double_le_of_even_ge_six
statement:
theorem nearestQTwoAdicOrder_double_le_of_even_ge_six
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    2 * nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by
    omega
  have hsPos :
      0 < nearestQTwoAdicOrder q :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pos_of_even
      q hqPos hqEven
  by_cases hsOne :
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder q = 1
  · omega
  · have hsTwo :
        2 ≤ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q := by
      omega
    have hpowDvd :
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ∣ q :=
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_pow_dvd q
    have hpowLe :
        2 ^ nearestQTwoAdicOrder q ≤ q :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd hqPos hpowDvd
    have haux :
        ∀ s : Nat,
          2 ≤ s →
          2 * s ≤ 2 ^ s := by
      intro s hs
      induction s with
      | zero =>
          omega
      | succ s ih =>
          by_cases hsOne' : s = 1
          · subst s
            norm_num
          · have hsTwo' : 2 ≤ s := by
              omega
            have hih := ih hsTwo'
            rw [pow_succ]
            omega
    exact le_trans
      (haux
        (nearestQTwoAdicOrder q)
        hsTwo)
      hpowLe

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQAddPow_eq_base_add_tail
statement:
theorem nearestQAddPow_eq_base_add_tail
    (q r : Nat) :
    ((2 * r + 1) + nearestQEvenShift q) ^ q =
      (2 * r + 1) ^ q +
        nearestQBinomialTail q r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Nat → Nat := fun j =>
    Nat.choose q j *
      (2 * r + 1) ^ (q - j) *
      nearestQEvenShift q ^ j
  have hfull :
      ((2 * r + 1) + nearestQEvenShift q) ^ q =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range (q + 1))
          f := by
    rw [add_comm, add_pow]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    simp only [f]
    ac_rfl
  have hzero :
      0 ∈ Finset.range (q + 1) := by
    simp
  calc
    ((2 * r + 1) + nearestQEvenShift q) ^ q =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range (q + 1))
          f :=
      hfull
    _ =
        f 0 +
          Finset.sum
            ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
            f := by
      calc
        Finset.sum
            (Finset.range (q + 1))
            f =
          Finset.sum
              ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
              f +
            f 0 := by
          symm
          exact
            Finset.sum_erase_add
              (Finset.range (q + 1))
              f
              hzero
        _ =
            f 0 +
              Finset.sum
                ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
                f := by
          ac_rfl
    _ =
        (2 * r + 1) ^ q +
          nearestQBinomialTail q r := by
      simp [f, nearestQBinomialTail]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQEvenLinearTerm_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQEvenLinearTerm_eq
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (_hqEven : Even q) :
    q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q =
      2 ^ (q - 1) * nearestQOddPart q
proof:
:= by
  let s :=
    nearestQTwoAdicOrder q
  let u :=
    nearestQOddPart q
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hsLt :
      s < q := by
    simpa [s] using
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_lt_self q hqPos
  have hdecomp :
      2 ^ s * u = q := by
    simpa [s, u] using
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_mul_oddPart q
  have hexponent :
      s + (q - 1 - s) = q - 1 := by
    omega
  unfold nearestQEvenResiduePeriod
  calc
    q * 2 ^ (q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q) =
        (2 ^ s * u) *
          2 ^ (q - 1 - s) := by
      rw [hdecomp]
    _ =
        (2 ^ s * 2 ^ (q - 1 - s)) * u := by
      ac_rfl
    _ =
        2 ^ (s + (q - 1 - s)) * u := by
      rw [pow_add]
    _ =
        2 ^ (q - 1) * u := by
      rw [hexponent]
    _ =
        2 ^ (q - 1) * nearestQOddPart q := by
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQEvenLinearTerm_not_dvd
statement:
theorem nearestQEvenLinearTerm_not_dvd
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    ¬2 ^ q ∣
      q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  intro hdiv
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
  rw [
    nearestQEvenLinearTerm_eq
      q hq hqEven
  ] at hk
  have hpow :
      2 ^ q =
        2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 := by
    calc
      2 ^ q =
          2 ^ ((q - 1) + 1) := by
        congr 1
        omega
      _ =
          2 ^ (q - 1) * 2 := by
        rw [pow_succ]
  rw [hpow] at hk
  have hk' :
      2 ^ (q - 1) * nearestQOddPart q =
        2 ^ (q - 1) * (2 * k) := by
    calc
      2 ^ (q - 1) * nearestQOddPart q =
          (2 ^ (q - 1) * 2) * k :=
        hk
      _ =
          2 ^ (q - 1) * (2 * k) := by
        ac_rfl
  have hoddPart :
      nearestQOddPart q = 2 * k := by
    exact
      Nat.mul_left_cancel
        (show 0 < 2 ^ (q - 1) by
          positivity)
        hk'
  apply nearestQOddPart_not_two_dvd q hqPos
  exact ⟨k, hoddPart⟩

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOneAddEvenPeriod_pow_eq
statement:

        Finset.sum

    rw [
      add_comm
        (1 : Nat)
        (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q),
      add_pow
    ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _hj
    simp [f, mul_comm]
  have hzero :
      0 ∈ Finset.range (q + 1) := by
    simp
  have hone :
      1 ∈
        (Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_erase]
    constructor
    · norm_num
    · rw [Finset.mem_range]
      omega
  have hsplitZero :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range (q + 1))
          f =
        f 0 +
          Finset.sum
            ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
            f := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range (q + 1))
          f =
        Finset.sum
            ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
            f +
          f 0 := by
        symm
        exact
          Finset.sum_erase_add
            (Finset.range (q + 1))
            f
            hzero
      _ =
          f 0 +
            Finset.sum
              ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
              f := by
        ac_rfl
  have hsplitOne :
      Finset.sum
          ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
          f =
        f 1 +
          Finset.sum
            (((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0).erase 1)
            f := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
          ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
          f =
        Finset.sum
            (((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0).erase 1)
            f +
          f 1 := by
        symm
        exact
          Finset.sum_erase_add
            ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
            f
            hone
      _ =
          f 1 +
            Finset.sum
              (((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0).erase 1)
              f := by
        ac_rfl
  calc
    (1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range (q + 1))
          f :=
      hfull
    _ =
        f 0 +
          Finset.sum
            ((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0)
            f :=
      hsplitZero
    _ =
        f 0 +
          (f 1 +
            Finset.sum
              (((Finset.range (q + 1)).erase 0).erase 1)
              f) := by
      rw [hsplitOne]
    _ =
        1 +
          q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q +
          nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q := by
      simp [
        f,
        nearestQEvenNonlinearTail,
        add_assoc
      ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOneAddEvenPeriod_pow_sub_one_not_dvd
statement:
theorem nearestQOneAddEvenPeriod_pow_sub_one_not_dvd
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    ¬2 ^ q ∣
      (1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q - 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiv
  rw [
    nearestQOneAddEvenPeriod_pow_eq
      q
      (by omega)
  ] at hdiv
  have hsub :
      (1 +
          q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q +
          nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q) -
          1 =
        q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q +
          nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q := by
    omega
  rw [hsub] at hdiv
  have htail :
      2 ^ q ∣ nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q :=
    nearestQEvenNonlinearTail_dvd
      q hq hqEven
  have hsumMod :
      (q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q +
          nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q) %
          2 ^ q =
        0 := by
    exact
      Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp
        hdiv
  have htailMod :
      nearestQEvenNonlinearTail q %
          2 ^ q =
        0 := by
    exact
      Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp
        htail
  have hlinearMod :
      (q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) %
          2 ^ q =
        0 := by
    simpa [Nat.add_mod, htailMod] using
      hsumMod
  have hlinear :
      2 ^ q ∣
        q * nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q := by
    exact
      Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr
        hlinearMod
  exact
    (nearestQEvenLinearTerm_not_dvd
      q hq hqEven)
      hlinear

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_evenHalfPeriod_ne_initial
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_evenHalfPeriod_ne_initial
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q
        (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) ≠
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q 0
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hqPos :
      0 < q := by
    omega
  have hzero :
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q 0 = 1 :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_zero q hqPos
  have hresidue :
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q
          (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) =
        1 := by
    exact heq.trans hzero
  rw [
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_oddPowerMod
  ] at hresidue
  rw [
    nearestQOddBase_at_evenHalfPeriod
      q hq hqEven
  ] at hresidue
  have honeLt :
      1 < 2 ^ q := by
    exact
      Nat.one_lt_two_pow
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hqPos)
  have hmod :
      Nat.ModEq
        (2 ^ q)
        ((1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q)
        1 := by
    change
      ((1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q) %
          2 ^ q =
        1 % 2 ^ q
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt honeLt]
    exact hresidue
  have honeLe :
      1 ≤
        (1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q := by
    simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
      (Nat.one_le_pow'
        q
        (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q))
  have hdvd :
      2 ^ q ∣
        (1 + nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) ^ q -
          1 := by
    exact
      (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' honeLe).1
        hmod.symm
  exact
    (nearestQOneAddEvenPeriod_pow_sub_one_not_dvd
      q hq hqEven)
      hdvd

name: RoundedRootSums.natPeriodic_mul
statement:
theorem natPeriodic_mul
    {α : Type*}
    (f : Nat → α)
    (d n : Nat)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic f d) :
    Function.Periodic f (n * d)
proof:
:= by
  exact hperiod.nat_mul n

name: RoundedRootSums.natPeriodic_mod
statement:
theorem natPeriodic_mod
    {α : Type*}
    (f : Nat → α)
    (P d : Nat)
    (hP : Function.Periodic f P)
    (hd : Function.Periodic f d) :
    Function.Periodic f (P % d)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hmultiple :
      Function.Periodic f ((P / d) * d) := by
    exact hd.nat_mul (P / d)
  have hdecomp :
      P % d + (P / d) * d = P := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
      Nat.mod_add_div P d
  calc
    f (x + P % d) =
        f ((x + P % d) + (P / d) * d) := by
      symm
      exact hmultiple (x + P % d)
    _ =
        f (x + P) := by
      rw [add_assoc, hdecomp]
    _ =
        f x := by
      exact hP x

name: RoundedRootSums.natPeriodic_gcd
statement:
theorem natPeriodic_gcd
    {α : Type*}
    (f : Nat → α)
    (m n : Nat)
    (hm : Function.Periodic f m)
    (hn : Function.Periodic f n) :
    Function.Periodic f (Nat.gcd m n)
proof:
:= by
  revert hm hn
  refine
    Nat.gcd.induction
      m n
      (fun n _ hn => ?_)
      (fun m n _ ih hm hn => ?_)
  · rwa [Nat.gcd_zero_left]
  · rw [Nat.gcd_rec]
    exact
      ih
        (natPeriodic_mod f n m hn hm)
        hm

name: RoundedRootSums.natProperDivisor_twoPow_dvd_predPow
statement:
theorem natProperDivisor_twoPow_dvd_predPow
    (a e : Nat)
    (ha : a ∣ 2 ^ e)
    (hlt : a < 2 ^ e) :
    a ∣ 2 ^ (e - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hkLe, hak⟩ :=
    (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).1 ha
  subst a
  have hkLt :
      k < e := by
    exact
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right
        (by norm_num : 1 < (2 : Nat))).1
        hlt
  have hkPred :
      k ≤ e - 1 := by
    omega
  exact
    Nat.pow_dvd_pow
      2
      hkPred

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQEvenGcd_dvd_halfPeriod
statement:
theorem nearestQEvenGcd_dvd_halfPeriod
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 6 ≤ q)
    (hqEven : Even q)
    (hdPos : 0 < d)
    (hdLt :
      d < nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q) :
    Nat.gcd
        (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
        d ∣
      nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q
proof:
:= by
  have hgDvdD :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d ∣ d :=
    Nat.gcd_dvd_right
      (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
      d
  have hgLeD :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d ≤ d :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd
      hdPos
      hgDvdD
  have hgLtPeriod :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d <
        nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt
      hgLeD
      hdLt
  have hgDvdPeriod :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d ∣
        nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q :=
    Nat.gcd_dvd_left
      (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
      d
  have hgDvdPredPow :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d ∣
        2 ^
          ((q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q) - 1) := by
    apply
      natProperDivisor_twoPow_dvd_predPow
        (Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d)
        (q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q)
    · simpa [nearestQEvenResiduePeriod] using
        hgDvdPeriod
    · simpa [nearestQEvenResiduePeriod] using
        hgLtPeriod
  have hexponent :
      (q - 1 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q) - 1 =
        q - 2 - nearestQTwoAdicOrder q := by
    have hbound :
        nearestQTwoAdicOrder q + 2 ≤ q :=
      nearestQTwoAdicOrder_add_two_le_of_even_ge_six
        q hq hqEven
    omega
  rw [hexponent] at hgDvdPredPow
  simpa [nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod] using
    hgDvdPredPow

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_even_period_le
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_even_period_le
    (q d : Nat)

      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        d) :
    nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hdLt :
      d < nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q := by
    exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hgPeriod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        (Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d) :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_even_gcd_periodic
      q d hq hqEven hd
  have hgDvdHalf :
      Nat.gcd
          (nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q)
          d ∣
        nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q :=
    nearestQEvenGcd_dvd_halfPeriod
      q d hq hqEven hdPos hdLt
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hgDvdHalf
  have hhalf :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        (nearestQEvenResidueHalfPeriod q) := by
    rw [hk]
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
      hgPeriod.nat_mul k
  exact
    (nearestQPowerResidueAt_evenHalfPeriod_not_periodic
      q hq hqEven)
      hhalf
