name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsLeastPositiveNatPeriod
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
      (nearestQExactPeriod q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQExactPeriod
  by_cases hExceptional :
      q = 2 ∨ q = 4
  · rw [if_pos hExceptional]
    rcases hExceptional with hqTwo | hqFour
    · subst q
      exact
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod_two
    · subst q
      exact
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod_four
  · rw [if_neg hExceptional]
    by_cases hqOdd :
        Odd q
    · rw [if_pos hqOdd]
      exact
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod_of_odd
          q hq hqOdd
    · rw [if_neg hqOdd]
      have hqEven :
          Even q := by
        obtain ⟨k, hkEven | hkOdd⟩ :=
          Nat.even_or_odd' q
        · exact
            ⟨k, by
              omega⟩
        · exfalso
          apply hqOdd
          exact
            ⟨k, by
              omega⟩
      have hqNeTwo :
          q ≠ 2 := by
        intro h
        apply hExceptional
        exact Or.inl h
      have hqNeFour :
          q ≠ 4 := by
        intro h
        apply hExceptional
        exact Or.inr h
      have hqSix :
          6 ≤ q := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hqEven
        omega
      exact
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_even_isLeastPositivePeriod
          q hqSix hqEven

theorem nearestQFourierInversePower_sum_zero
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellPos : 0 < ell)
    (hellLt :
      ell < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun r =>
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
            (ell * r)) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  have hinvPrimitive :
      IsPrimitiveRoot
        ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹)
        (nearestQExactPeriod q) :=
    nearestQFourierRoot_inv_isPrimitiveRoot
      q hq
  have hbaseNe :
      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell ≠
        1 := by
    exact
      hinvPrimitive.pow_ne_one_of_pos_of_lt
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hellPos)
        hellLt
  have hbasePow :
      ((((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell) ^
          nearestQExactPeriod q) =
        1 := by
    rw [
      ← pow_mul,
      Nat.mul_comm
        ell
        (nearestQExactPeriod q),
      pow_mul,
      nearestQFourierRoot_inv_pow_exactPeriod
        q hq,
      one_pow
    ]
  have honeSubNe :
      (1 : ℂ) -
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell ≠
        0 := by
    exact
      sub_ne_zero.mpr hbaseNe.symm
  have hgeom :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            (((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell) ^ r) =
        0 := by
    refine
      eq_zero_of_ne_zero_of_mul_left_eq_zero
        honeSubNe
        ?_
    rw [
      mul_neg_geom_sum,
      hbasePow,
      sub_self

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierInverseShiftedPower_sum_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierInverseShiftedPower_sum_zero
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellPos : 0 < ell)
    (hellLt :
      ell < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun r =>
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
            (ell * (r + 1))) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
              (ell * r)) =
        0 :=
    nearestQFourierInversePower_sum_zero
      q ell hq hellPos hellLt
  calc
    Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
              (ell * (r + 1))) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                (ell * r) *
              ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _hr
      rw [
        Nat.mul_add,
        Nat.mul_one,
        pow_add
      ]
    _ =
        (Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
              (ell * r))) *
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hbase, zero_mul]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierPhaseRatio_ne_one
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierPhaseRatio_ne_one
    (q a b : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha :
      a < nearestQExactPeriod q)
    (hb :
      b < nearestQExactPeriod q)
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b ≠
      1
proof:
:= by
  intro hratio
  have hzNe :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ≠ 0 :=
    nearestQFourierRoot_ne_zero q
  have hcancel :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a *
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b := by
    calc
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a *
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) =
          (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a *
              (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b := by
        rw [← mul_assoc]
      _ =
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q *
              (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ a) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b := by
        rw [← mul_pow]
      _ = nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b := by
        simp [hzNe]
  have hphase :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a := by
    calc
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b =
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a *
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) :=
        hcancel.symm
      _ = nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a * 1 := by
        rw [hratio]
      _ = nearestQFourierRoot q ^ a := by
        rw [mul_one]
  have habEq :
      a = b :=
    (nearestQFourierRoot_isPrimitiveRoot
      q hq).pow_inj
        ha hb hphase.symm
  exact hab habEq

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierPhase_different_sum
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierPhase_different_sum
    (q a b : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha :
      a < nearestQExactPeriod q)
    (hb :
      b < nearestQExactPeriod q)
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun ell =>
          (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ (ell * a) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * b)) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  have hbaseNe :
      (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b ≠
        1 :=
    nearestQFourierPhaseRatio_ne_one
      q a b hq ha hb hab
  have hbasePow :
      (((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) ^
          nearestQExactPeriod q) =
        1 :=
    nearestQFourierPhaseRatio_pow_exactPeriod
      q a b hq
  have honeSubNe :
      (1 : ℂ) -
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) ≠
        0 := by
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hbaseNe.symm
  have hgeom :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun ell =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) ^ ell) =
        0 := by
    refine
      eq_zero_of_ne_zero_of_mul_left_eq_zero
        honeSubNe
        ?_
    rw [
      mul_neg_geom_sum,
      hbasePow,
      sub_self
    ]
  calc
    Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun ell =>
            (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ (ell * a) *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * b)) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun ell =>
            ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) ^ ell) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ell _hell
      rw [mul_pow]
      apply congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℂ => x * y)
      · calc
          (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ (ell * a) =
              (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ (a * ell) := by
            rw [Nat.mul_comm ell a]
          _ =
              ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ a) ^ ell :=
            pow_mul _ _ _
      · calc
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * b) =
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (b * ell) := by
            rw [Nat.mul_comm ell b]
          _ =
              (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ b) ^ ell :=
            pow_mul _ _ _
    _ = 0 := hgeom

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierPhase_orthogonality
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierPhase_orthogonality
    (q a b : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha :
      a < nearestQExactPeriod q)
    (hb :
      b < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun ell =>
          (nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹ ^ (ell * a) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * b)) =
      if a = b then
        (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)
      else
        0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact nearestQFourierPhase_same_sum q a
  · rw [if_neg hab]
    exact
      nearestQFourierPhase_different_sum
        q a b hq ha hb hab

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierShiftedPhase_mul_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierShiftedPhase_mul_eq
    (q ell r t : Nat) :
    ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
          (ell * (r + 1)) *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * (t + 1)) =
      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
          (ell * r) *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * t)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel :
      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell =
        1 := by
    simp [nearestQFourierRoot_ne_zero]
  rw [
    Nat.mul_add,
    Nat.mul_one,
    Nat.mul_add,
    Nat.mul_one,
    pow_add,
    pow_add
  ]
  calc
    ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ (ell * r) *
          ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell *
          (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * t) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) =
        (((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ (ell * r) *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * t)) *
          (((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ ell *
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) := by
      ring
    _ =
        ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^ (ell * r) *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ (ell * t) := by
      rw [hcancel, mul_one]

theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq_scaledDoubleSum

                (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *

                  nearestQFourierRoot q ^

proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff

    Finset.sum
          (Finset.range

                        (ell * (r + 1)))) *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^

        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))

            (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
              (Finset.sum
                  (Finset.range
                    (nearestQExactPeriod q))
                  (fun r =>
                    (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                        (ell * (r + 1))) *
                nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                  (ell * (t + 1)))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ell _hell
      ring
    _ =
        (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun ell =>
              Finset.sum
                  (Finset.range
                    (nearestQExactPeriod q))
                  (fun r =>
                    (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                      ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                        (ell * (r + 1))) *
                nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                  (ell * (t + 1))) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ =
        (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun ell =>
              Finset.sum
                (Finset.range
                  (nearestQExactPeriod q))
                (fun r =>
                  (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                    ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                      (ell * (r + 1)) *
                    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                      (ell * (t + 1)))) := by
      apply congrArg
        (fun z : ℂ =>
          (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) * z)
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

    _ =
        (1 / (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)) *
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              Finset.sum
                (Finset.range
                  (nearestQExactPeriod q))

                  (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ht :
      t < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries q t =
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodNe :
      (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.ne_of_gt
        (nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hq))
  have hdouble :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            Finset.sum
              (Finset.range
                (nearestQExactPeriod q))
              (fun ell =>
                (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                  ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                    (ell * (r + 1)) *
                  nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                    (ell * (t + 1)))) =
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) *
          (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ) := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              Finset.sum
                (Finset.range
                  (nearestQExactPeriod q))
                (fun ell =>
                  (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                    ((nearestQFourierRoot q)⁻¹) ^
                      (ell * (r + 1)) *
                    nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                      (ell * (t + 1)))) =
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              if r = t then
                (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r : ℂ) *
                  (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ)
              else
                0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r hr
        exact
          nearestQCenteredOmega_mul_shiftedPhase_sum
            q r t hq
            (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
            ht
      _ =
          (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) *
            (nearestQExactPeriod q : ℂ) := by
        simp [ht]
  rw [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq_scaledDoubleSum,
    hdouble
  ]
  field_simp [hperiodNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq_fourierSeries
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq_fourierSeries
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries q t =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q t
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodPos :
      0 < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hq
  have hrange :
      Finset.range (nearestQExactPeriod q) =
        ({0} : Finset Nat) ∪
          Finset.Ico 1 (nearestQExactPeriod q) := by
    ext ell
    simp only [
      Finset.mem_range,
      Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_singleton,
      Finset.mem_Ico
    ]
    omega
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint
        ({0} : Finset Nat)
        (Finset.Ico 1 (nearestQExactPeriod q)) := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro ell hellZero hellIco
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hellZero
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hellIco
    omega
  unfold
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries
  rw [
    hrange,
    Finset.sum_union hdisjoint
  ]
  simp [
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff_zero
      q hq
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_periodic
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_periodic
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Function.Periodic
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q)
      (nearestQExactPeriod q)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  unfold nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ell _hell
  have hphase :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell *
            ((t + 1) +
              nearestQExactPeriod q)) =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * (t + 1)) :=
    nearestQFourierPower_periodic
      q ell hq (t + 1)
  have hindex :
      (t + nearestQExactPeriod q) + 1 =
        (t + 1) + nearestQExactPeriod q := by
    omega
  rw [
    hindex,
    hphase
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_eq
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q t =
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodPos :
      0 < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hq
  have hmodLt :
      t % nearestQExactPeriod q <
        nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    Nat.mod_lt t hperiodPos
  calc
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q t =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q
          (t % nearestQExactPeriod q) := by
      symm
      exact
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_periodic
          q hq).map_mod_nat t
    _ =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries q
          (t % nearestQExactPeriod q) := by
      symm
      exact
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq_fourierSeries
          q
          (t % nearestQExactPeriod q)
          hq
    _ =
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q
          (t % nearestQExactPeriod q) : ℂ) :=
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFullFourierSeries_eq
        q
        (t % nearestQExactPeriod q)
        hq
        hmodLt
    _ =
        (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) := by
      exact
        congrArg
          (fun x : Rat => (x : ℂ))
          (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_mod_eq
            q t hq)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierRoot_pow_sub_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierRoot_pow_sub_one_ne_zero
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellPos : 0 < ell)
    (hellLt :
      ell < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell - 1 ≠ 0
proof:

    sub_ne_zero.mpr
      (nearestQFourierRoot_pow_ne_one
        q ell hq hellPos hellLt)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff_mul_sub
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff_mul_sub
    (q ell : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellPos : 0 < ell)
    (hellLt :
      ell < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
        (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell - 1) =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff
  field_simp [
    nearestQFourierRoot_pow_sub_one_ne_zero
      q ell hq hellPos hellLt
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_zero
    (q : Nat) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro ell _hell
  simp

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierTerm_succ_sub
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierTerm_succ_sub
    (q ell t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hellPos : 0 < ell)
    (hellLt :
      ell < nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
          (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell * ((t + 1) + 1)) -
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) -
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
          (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell * (t + 1)) -
            nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hphase :
      nearestQFourierRoot q ^
          (ell * ((t + 1) + 1)) =
        nearestQFourierRoot q ^
            (ell * (t + 1)) *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell := by
    rw [
      Nat.mul_add,
      Nat.mul_one,
      pow_add
    ]
  have hcoeff :
      nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
          (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell - 1) =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell :=
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff_mul_sub
      q ell hq hellPos hellLt
  rw [hphase]
  calc
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
            (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                  (ell * (t + 1)) *
                nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell -
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) -
          nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
            (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                  (ell * (t + 1)) -
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell) =
        (nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
            (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell - 1)) *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^
            (ell * (t + 1)) := by
      ring
    _ =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
          nearestQFourierRoot q ^
            (ell * (t + 1)) := by
      rw [hcoeff]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredSeries
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredSeries
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q (t + 1) -
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t =
      nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries q t
proof:
:= by
  unfold
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ell hell
  have hellBounds :
      1 ≤ ell ∧
        ell < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    Finset.mem_Ico.mp hell
  exact
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierTerm_succ_sub
      q ell t hq
      (by omega)
      hellBounds.2

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredOmega
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredOmega
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q (t + 1) -
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t =
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredSeries
      q t hq,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_eq
      q t hq
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_eq_omegaTilde
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_eq_omegaTilde
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t =
      (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ t ih =>
      have hdiff :
          nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q (t + 1) -
              nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t =
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) :=
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_succ_sub_eq_centeredOmega
          q t hq
      calc
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q (t + 1) =
            (nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q (t + 1) -
                nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t) +
              nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t := by
          ring
        _ =
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) +
              nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries q t := by
          rw [hdiff]
        _ =
            (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) +
              (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t : ℂ) := by
          rw [ih]
        _ =
            ((nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t +
                nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : Rat) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        _ =
            (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1) : ℂ) := by
          rw [
            ← nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ
              q t hq
          ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_fourierFormula
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_fourierFormula
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t : ℂ) =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Ico
          1
          (nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun ell =>
          nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
            (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell * (t + 1)) -
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries] using
    (nearestQOmegaTildeFourierSeries_eq_omegaTilde
      q t hq).symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQFourierMainTheorem
statement:
theorem nearestQFourierMainTheorem
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∀ t : Nat,
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t : ℂ) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Ico
            1
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun ell =>
            nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell *
              nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                (ell * (t + 1)))) ∧
      (∀ t : Nat,
        (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t : ℂ) =
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.Ico
              1
              (nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun ell =>
              nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
                (nearestQFourierRoot q ^
                    (ell * (t + 1)) -
                  nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell))) ∧
      (∀ ell : Nat,
        0 < ell →
        ell < nearestQExactPeriod q →
        nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff q ell *
            (nearestQFourierRoot q ^ ell - 1) =
          nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierCoeff q ell)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    simpa [nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries] using
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaFourierSeries_eq
        q t hq).symm
  · intro t
    exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_fourierFormula
        q t hq
  · intro ell hellPos hellLt
    exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeFourierCoeff_mul_sub
        q ell hq hellPos hellLt

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_eq_periodicForm
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_eq_periodicForm
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t =
      shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodicForm q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodicForm
  unfold shiftedResiduePeriodicRemainder
  exact shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_div_mod
    q a b t hq ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedSum_cast_rat_eq_periodicBernoulli
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedSum_cast_rat_eq_periodicBernoulli
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n : Rat) =
      shiftedRealRoundedSumBernoulliPeriodic q a b n
proof:
:= by
  let t := shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n
  have hcut :
      IsShiftedCutoff q a b n
        (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) :=
    shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff q a b n hb ha
  have hadd :=
    shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
      q a b n (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
      hb ha hcut
  have hthresholdMax :
      shiftedThresholdSum q a b
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) ≤
        shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) := by
    omega
  have hthreshold :
      shiftedThresholdSum q a b t ≤
        t * (n + 1) := by
    simpa [t,
      shiftedMaxLevel_eq_realRoundedValue
        q a b n hq hb ha] using hthresholdMax
  have hsplit :=
    shiftedThresholdSum_eq_quotientSum_add_correctionSum
      q a b t hb ha
  have hparts :
      shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t +
          shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t ≤
        t * (n + 1) := by
    rw [← hsplit]
    exact hthreshold
  have hNat :
      shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
        t * (n + 1) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t) := by
    simpa [t] using
      (shiftedRealRoundedSum_residue_formula
        q a b n hq hb ha)
  have hRat :
      (shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n : Rat) =
        (t : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          ((shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) +
            (shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t : Rat)) := by
    have hCast :=
      congrArg (fun x : Nat => (x : Rat)) hNat
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hparts] at hCast
    simpa only [
      Nat.cast_mul,
      Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one
    ] using hCast
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedSumBernoulliPeriodic
  calc
    (shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n : Rat) =
        (t : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          ((shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) +
            (shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t : Rat)) :=
      hRat
    _ =
        (t : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientBernoulliPeriodic q a b t +
            (shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodicForm
              q a b t : Rat)) := by
      rw [shiftedPowerQuotientSum_cast_rat_eq_periodicBernoulli
        q a b t hq hb ha]
      rw [shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_eq_periodicForm
        q a b t hq ha]
    _ =
        (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n : Rat) *
            ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientBernoulliPeriodic q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
            (shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodicForm q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) : Rat)) := by
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalExponent_pos
statement:
theorem rationalExponent_pos
    (p q : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    0 < rationalExponent p q
proof:
:= by
  have hpR :
      (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hp
  have hqR :
      (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  unfold rationalExponent
  exact div_pos hpR hqR

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalExponent_inv
statement:
theorem rationalExponent_inv
    (p q : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (rationalExponent p q)⁻¹ =
      rationalExponent q p
proof:
:= by
  have hpNe :
      (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hp)
  have hqNe :
      (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  unfold rationalExponent
  field_simp [hpNe, hqNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalPowerReciprocity
statement:
theorem rationalPowerReciprocity
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
      rationalCeilPowerSum
        q p
        (realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n) =
      (n + 1) *
        realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n
proof:
:= by
  have hExpPos :
      0 < rationalExponent p q :=
    rationalExponent_pos p q hp hq
  have hInv :
      (rationalExponent p q)⁻¹ =
        rationalExponent q p :=
    rationalExponent_inv p q hp hq
  unfold
    rationalFloorPowerSum
    rationalCeilPowerSum
  rw [← hInv]
  exact
    realPowerReciprocity
      (rationalExponent p q)
      n
      hExpPos

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_iff_floorRoot_pow_eq
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_iff_floorRoot_pow_eq
    (q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k ↔
      Nat.floorRoot q k ^ q = k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [
      Nat.floorRoot_pow_self
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
    ]
  · intro h
    exact
      ⟨Nat.floorRoot q k, h⟩

name: RoundedRootSums.factorization_dvd_of_isPerfectNatPower
statement:
theorem factorization_dvd_of_isPerfectNatPower
    (q k ℓ : Nat)
    (hperfect : IsPerfectNatPower q k) :
    q ∣ k.factorization ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hperfect with ⟨a, rfl⟩
  simp [Nat.factorization_pow]

name: RoundedRootSums.factorization_mul_eq_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem factorization_mul_eq_of_pow_eq_pow
    (p q x k ℓ : Nat)
    (hpow :
      x ^ q = k ^ p) :
    q * x.factorization ℓ =
      p * k.factorization ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hfac :
      (x ^ q).factorization =
        (k ^ p).factorization := by
    rw [hpow]
  have happ :=
    congrArg
      (fun f : Nat →₀ Nat => f ℓ)
      hfac
  simpa [Nat.factorization_pow] using happ

name: RoundedRootSums.dvd_right_of_coprime_mul_eq
statement:
theorem dvd_right_of_coprime_mul_eq
    (p q a b : Nat)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (h :
      q * a = p * b) :
    q ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv :
      q ∣ p * b := by
    rw [← h]
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact
    (hpq.symm.dvd_mul_left).mp hdiv

name: RoundedRootSums.factorization_dvd_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem factorization_dvd_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
    (p q x k ℓ : Nat)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (hpow :
      x ^ q = k ^ p) :
    q ∣ k.factorization ℓ
proof:
:= by
  apply
    dvd_right_of_coprime_mul_eq
      p q
      (x.factorization ℓ)
      (k.factorization ℓ)
      hpq
  exact
    factorization_mul_eq_of_pow_eq_pow
      p q x k ℓ hpow

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_of_factorization_dvd
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_of_factorization_dvd
    (q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdiv :
      ∀ ℓ : Nat,
        q ∣ k.factorization ℓ) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    exact
      ⟨0, by
        simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hq]⟩
  · apply
      (isPerfectNatPower_iff_floorRoot_pow_eq
        q k hq).2
    apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq'
    · exact
        pow_ne_zero
          _
          (Nat.floorRoot_ne_zero.2
            ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hq, hk⟩)
    · exact hk
    · rw [
        Nat.factorization_pow,
        Nat.factorization_floorRoot
      ]
      ext ℓ
      simp only [
        Finsupp.smul_apply,
        Finsupp.floorDiv_apply,
        Nat.floorDiv_eq_div,
        nsmul_eq_mul
      ]
      exact
        Nat.mul_div_cancel'
          (hdiv ℓ)

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_iff_factorization_dvd
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_iff_factorization_dvd
    (q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k ↔
      ∀ ℓ : Nat,
        q ∣ k.factorization ℓ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hperfect ℓ
    exact
      factorization_dvd_of_isPerfectNatPower
        q k ℓ hperfect
  · intro hdiv
    exact
      isPerfectNatPower_of_factorization_dvd
        q k hq hdiv

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
    (p q x k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (hpow :
      x ^ q = k ^ p) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  apply
    isPerfectNatPower_of_factorization_dvd
      q k hq
  intro ℓ
  exact
    factorization_dvd_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
      p q x k ℓ hpq hpow

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalExponent_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem rationalExponent_mul_denominator
    (p q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    rationalExponent p q * (q : ℝ) = (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalExponent
  have hqNe :
      (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hq
  field_simp [hqNe]

name: RoundedRootSums.pow_eq_pow_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem pow_eq_pow_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
    (p q k x : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (h :
      Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q) =
      (x : ℝ)) :
    k ^ p = x ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have hkNonneg :
      0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hexp :
      rationalExponent p q * (q : ℝ) =
        (p : ℝ) :=
    rationalExponent_mul_denominator
      p q hq
  have hpow :
      Real.rpow
          (k : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q * (q : ℝ)) =
        Real.rpow
          (x : ℝ)
          (q : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.rpow
          (k : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q * (q : ℝ)) =
        Real.rpow
          (Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q))
          (q : ℝ) := by
            exact
              Real.rpow_mul
                hkNonneg
                (rationalExponent p q)
                (q : ℝ)
      _ =
        Real.rpow
          (x : ℝ)
          (q : ℝ) := by
            rw [h]
  rw [hexp] at hpow
  have hpowNat :
      (k : ℝ) ^ p =
        (x : ℝ) ^ q := by
    calc
      (k : ℝ) ^ p =
          Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (p : ℝ) := by
        symm
        exact Real.rpow_natCast (k : ℝ) p
      _ =
          Real.rpow
            (x : ℝ)
            (q : ℝ) :=
        hpow
      _ =
          (x : ℝ) ^ q := by
        exact Real.rpow_natCast (x : ℝ) q
  exact_mod_cast hpowNat

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
    (p q k x : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (h :
      Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q) =
      (x : ℝ)) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  apply
    isPerfectNatPower_of_coprime_pow_eq_pow
      p q x k hq hpq
  symm
  exact
    pow_eq_pow_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
      p q k x hq h

name: RoundedRootSums.rpow_rational_of_nat_pow
statement:
theorem rpow_rational_of_nat_pow
    (p q a : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Real.rpow
        ((a ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q) =
      ((a ^ p : Nat) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have haNonneg :
      0 ≤ (a : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hexp :
      (q : ℝ) * rationalExponent p q =
        (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact
      rationalExponent_mul_denominator
        p q hq
  have hqPow :
      (a : ℝ) ^ q =
        Real.rpow
          (a : ℝ)
          (q : ℝ) := by
    symm
    exact
      Real.rpow_natCast
        (a : ℝ)
        q
  calc
    Real.rpow
        ((a ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q) =
      Real.rpow
        ((a : ℝ) ^ q)
        (rationalExponent p q) := by
          norm_num
    _ =
      Real.rpow
        (Real.rpow
          (a : ℝ)
          (q : ℝ))
        (rationalExponent p q) := by
          rw [hqPow]
    _ =
      Real.rpow
        (a : ℝ)
        ((q : ℝ) * rationalExponent p q) := by
          symm
          exact
            Real.rpow_mul
              haNonneg
              (q : ℝ)
              (rationalExponent p q)
    _ =
      Real.rpow
        (a : ℝ)
        (p : ℝ) := by
          rw [hexp]
    _ =
      (a : ℝ) ^ p := by
          exact
            Real.rpow_natCast
              (a : ℝ)
              p
    _ =
      ((a ^ p : Nat) : ℝ) := by
          norm_num

name: RoundedRootSums.rpow_rational_isNat_iff_isPerfectNatPower
statement:
theorem rpow_rational_isNat_iff_isPerfectNatPower
    (p q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    (∃ x : Nat,
        Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q) =
          (x : ℝ)) ↔
      IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact
      isPerfectNatPower_of_rpow_rational_eq_natCast
        p q k x hq hpq hx
  · intro hperfect
    rcases hperfect with ⟨a, ha⟩
    subst k
    refine ⟨a ^ p, ?_⟩
    exact
      rpow_rational_of_nat_pow
        p q a hq

name: RoundedRootSums.isPerfectNatPower_iff_nthRoot_pow_eq
statement:
theorem isPerfectNatPower_iff_nthRoot_pow_eq
    (q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsPerfectNatPower q k ↔
      Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsPerfectNatPower
  exact
    Nat.exists_pow_eq_iff'
      (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_perfectNatPowersUpTo_iff
statement:
theorem mem_perfectNatPowersUpTo_iff
    (q n k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    k ∈ perfectNatPowersUpTo q n ↔
      k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n ∧
        IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hqNe :
      q ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt hq
  constructor
  · intro hk
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hk with
      ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    have haBounds :
        1 ≤ a ∧
          a ≤ Nat.nthRoot q n :=
      Finset.mem_Icc.mp ha
    constructor
    · apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      constructor
      · exact
          (one_le_pow_iff hqNe).2
            haBounds.1
      · exact
          (Nat.le_nthRoot_iff hqNe).1
            haBounds.2
    · exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hk, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩
    subst k
    have hkBounds :
        1 ≤ a ^ q ∧
          a ^ q ≤ n :=
      Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    constructor
    · exact
        (one_le_pow_iff hqNe).1
          hkBounds.1
    · exact
        (Nat.le_nthRoot_iff hqNe).2
          hkBounds.2

name: RoundedRootSums.perfectNatPowersUpTo_card
statement:
theorem perfectNatPowersUpTo_card
    (q n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (perfectNatPowersUpTo q n).card =
      Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  unfold perfectNatPowersUpTo
  rw [
    Finset.card_image_of_injective
      (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.nthRoot q n))
      (pow_left_injective
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hq))
  ]
  simp [Nat.card_Icc]

name: RoundedRootSums.natCeil_eq_natFloor_iff_exists_natCast
statement:
theorem natCeil_eq_natFloor_iff_exists_natCast
    (y : ℝ)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    ⌈y⌉₊ = ⌊y⌋₊ ↔
      ∃ m : Nat, y = (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hEq
    refine ⟨⌊y⌋₊, ?_⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hceil :
          y ≤ (⌈y⌉₊ : ℝ) :=
        Nat.le_ceil y
      simpa [hEq] using hceil
    · exact
        Nat.floor_le hy
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
    simp

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_iff
statement:
theorem rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_iff
    (p q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    ⌈Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ =
      ⌊Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ ↔
      IsPerfectNatPower q k
proof:
:= by
  have hyNonneg :
      0 ≤
        Real.rpow
          (k : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) := by
    exact
      Real.rpow_nonneg
        (by positivity)
        (rationalExponent p q)
  rw [
    natCeil_eq_natFloor_iff_exists_natCast
      _
      hyNonneg
  ]
  exact
    rpow_rational_isNat_iff_isPerfectNatPower
      p q k hq hpq

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_add_indicator
statement:
theorem rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_add_indicator
    (p q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    ⌈Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ =
      ⌊Real.rpow
        (k : ℝ)
        (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ +
        if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hroot :
      Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
  · have hperfect :
        IsPerfectNatPower q k :=
      (isPerfectNatPower_iff_nthRoot_pow_eq
        q k hq).2 hroot
    have hEq :
        ⌈Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ =
          ⌊Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ :=
      (rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_iff
        p q k hq hpq).2 hperfect
    rw [if_pos hroot, Nat.add_zero]
    exact hEq
  · have hnotPerfect :
        ¬ IsPerfectNatPower q k := by
      intro hperfect
      apply hroot
      exact
        (isPerfectNatPower_iff_nthRoot_pow_eq
          q k hq).1 hperfect
    have hNe :
        ⌈Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ ≠
          ⌊Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ := by
      intro hEq
      apply hnotPerfect
      exact
        (rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_iff
          p q k hq hpq).1 hEq
    have hLower :
        ⌊Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ ≤
          ⌈Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ :=
      Nat.floor_le_ceil _
    have hUpper :
        ⌈Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ ≤
          ⌊Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ + 1 :=
      Nat.ceil_le_floor_add_one _
    have hSucc :
        ⌈Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊ =
          ⌊Real.rpow
            (k : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [if_neg hroot]
    exact hSucc

name: RoundedRootSums.perfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
statement:
theorem perfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
    (q n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
          then 1
          else 0) =
      Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k =>
            Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k) =
        perfectNatPowersUpTo q n := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    rw [
      mem_perfectNatPowersUpTo_iff
        q n k hq,
      isPerfectNatPower_iff_nthRoot_pow_eq
        q k hq
    ]
  have hcard :
      ((Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k =>
            Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k)).card =
        Nat.nthRoot q n := by
    rw [hfilter]
    exact
      perfectNatPowersUpTo_card
        q n hq
  exact_mod_cast hcard

name: RoundedRootSums.nonPerfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
statement:
theorem nonPerfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
    (q n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
          then 0
          else 1) =
      n - Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htotal :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
            then 0
            else 1) +
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
            then 1
            else 0) =
        n := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
            (Finset.Icc 1 n)
            (fun k =>
              if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
              then 0
              else 1) +
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.Icc 1 n)
            (fun k =>
              if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
              then 1
              else 0) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            (if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
             then 0
             else 1) +
            (if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
             then 1
             else 0)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun _ => 1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _hk
          by_cases h :
              Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
          · simp [h]
          · simp [h]
      _ = n := by
          simp [Nat.card_Icc]
  have hperfect :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
            then 1
            else 0) =
        Nat.nthRoot q n :=
    perfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
      q n hq
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalCeilPowerSum_eq_floorPowerSum_add_correction
statement:
theorem rationalCeilPowerSum_eq_floorPowerSum_add_correction
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    rationalCeilPowerSum p q n =
      rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        (n - Nat.nthRoot q n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold
    rationalCeilPowerSum
    rationalFloorPowerSum
    realCeilPowerSum
    realFloorPowerSum
  calc
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          ⌈Real.rpow
              (k : ℝ)
              (rationalExponent p q)⌉₊) =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          ⌊Real.rpow
              (k : ℝ)
              (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊ +
            if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
            then 0
            else 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _hk
      exact
        rationalRpow_ceil_eq_floor_add_indicator
          p q k hq hpq
    _ =
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            ⌊Real.rpow
                (k : ℝ)
                (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊) +
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if Nat.nthRoot q k ^ q = k
            then 0
            else 1) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ =
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            ⌊Real.rpow
                (k : ℝ)
                (rationalExponent p q)⌋₊) +
        (n - Nat.nthRoot q n) := by
      rw [
        nonPerfectNatPowerIndicatorSum
          q n hq
      ]

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalFloorPowerReciprocity_with_correction
statement:
theorem rationalFloorPowerReciprocity_with_correction
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q) n) +
        (realFloorPowerCutoff
              (rationalExponent p q) n -
          Nat.nthRoot p
            (realFloorPowerCutoff
              (rationalExponent p q) n)) =
      (n + 1) *
        realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q) n
proof:
:= by
  let r :=
    realFloorPowerCutoff
      (rationalExponent p q) n
  have hceil :
      rationalCeilPowerSum q p r =
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p r +
          (r - Nat.nthRoot p r) := by
    exact
      rationalCeilPowerSum_eq_floorPowerSum_add_correction
        q p r hp hpq.symm
  have hrec :
      rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
          rationalCeilPowerSum q p r =
        (n + 1) * r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact
      rationalPowerReciprocity
        p q n hp hq
  change
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p r +
        (r - Nat.nthRoot p r) =
      (n + 1) * r
  rw [Nat.add_assoc, ← hceil]
  exact hrec

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalFloorPowerCutoff_root_bounds
statement:
theorem rationalFloorPowerCutoff_root_bounds
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Nat.nthRoot q n ^ p ≤
        realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n ∧
      realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n <
        (Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hqNe :
      q ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt hq
  have hExpPos :
      0 < rationalExponent p q :=
    rationalExponent_pos
      p q hp hq
  have hrootLower :
      Nat.nthRoot q n ^ q ≤ n := by
    exact
      (Nat.le_nthRoot_iff hqNe).1
        le_rfl
  have hrootUpper :
      n <
        (Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ q :=
    Nat.lt_pow_nthRoot_add_one
      hqNe n
  have hrootLowerR :
      ((Nat.nthRoot q n ^ q : Nat) : ℝ) ≤
        (n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hrootLower
  have hrootUpperR :
      (n : ℝ) <
        (((Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ q : Nat) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hrootUpper
  have hmonoLower :
      Real.rpow
          ((Nat.nthRoot q n ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) ≤
        Real.rpow
          (n : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) := by
    exact
      Real.rpow_le_rpow
        (by positivity)
        hrootLowerR
        (le_of_lt hExpPos)
  have hlowerReal :
      ((Nat.nthRoot q n ^ p : Nat) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.rpow
          (n : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) := by
    calc
      ((Nat.nthRoot q n ^ p : Nat) : ℝ) =
          Real.rpow
            ((Nat.nthRoot q n ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q) := by
        symm
        exact
          rpow_rational_of_nat_pow
            p q
            (Nat.nthRoot q n)
            hq
      _ ≤
          Real.rpow
            (n : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q) :=
        hmonoLower
  have hmonoUpper :
      Real.rpow
          (n : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) <
        Real.rpow
          (((Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) := by
    exact
      Real.rpow_lt_rpow
        (by positivity)
        hrootUpperR
        hExpPos
  have hupperReal :
      Real.rpow
          (n : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) <
        (((Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ p : Nat) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.rpow
          (n : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) <
        Real.rpow
          (((Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ q : Nat) : ℝ)
          (rationalExponent p q) :=
        hmonoUpper
      _ =
        (((Nat.nthRoot q n + 1) ^ p : Nat) : ℝ) := by
        exact
          rpow_rational_of_nat_pow
            p q
            (Nat.nthRoot q n + 1)
            hq
  constructor
  · unfold realFloorPowerCutoff
    exact
      Nat.le_floor
        hlowerReal
  · have hyNonneg :
        0 ≤
          Real.rpow
            (n : ℝ)
            (rationalExponent p q) := by
      exact
        Real.rpow_nonneg
          (by positivity)
          (rationalExponent p q)
    unfold realFloorPowerCutoff
    exact
      (Nat.floor_lt hyNonneg).2
        hupperReal

name: RoundedRootSums.nthRoot_rationalFloorPowerCutoff
statement:
theorem nthRoot_rationalFloorPowerCutoff
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Nat.nthRoot p
        (realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n) =
      Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  rcases
      rationalFloorPowerCutoff_root_bounds
        p q n hp hq with
    ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  exact
    Nat.nthRoot_eq_of_le_of_lt
      hlower
      hupper

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalFloorPowerReciprocity
statement:
theorem rationalFloorPowerReciprocity
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n) =
      n *
          realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
        Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  let r :=
    realFloorPowerCutoff
      (rationalExponent p q)
      n
  let a :=
    Nat.nthRoot q n
  have hroot :
      Nat.nthRoot p r = a := by
    dsimp [r, a]
    exact
      nthRoot_rationalFloorPowerCutoff
        p q n hp hq
  have hapowLe :
      a ^ p ≤ r := by
    dsimp [a, r]
    exact
      (rationalFloorPowerCutoff_root_bounds
        p q n hp hq).1
  have haLePow :
      a ≤ a ^ p := by
    exact
      Nat.le_self_pow
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hp)
        a
  have haLeR :
      a ≤ r :=
    haLePow.trans hapowLe
  have hrSplit :
      a + (r - a) = r := by
    omega
  have hrec :
      rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
          rationalFloorPowerSum q p r +
          (r - Nat.nthRoot p r) =
        (n + 1) * r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact
      rationalFloorPowerReciprocity_with_correction
        p q n hp hq hpq
  rw [hroot] at hrec
  change
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p r =
      n * r + a
  have hright :
      (n + 1) * r =
        (n * r + a) + (r - a) := by
    calc
      (n + 1) * r =
          n * r + r := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul]
        simp
      _ =
          n * r + (a + (r - a)) := by
        rw [hrSplit]
      _ =
          (n * r + a) + (r - a) := by
        ac_rfl
  have hcancel :
      (rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
          rationalFloorPowerSum q p r) +
          (r - a) =
        (n * r + a) +
          (r - a) := by
    calc
      (rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
          rationalFloorPowerSum q p r) +
          (r - a) =
        (n + 1) * r :=
          hrec
      _ =
        (n * r + a) +
          (r - a) :=
          hright
  exact
    Nat.add_right_cancel hcancel

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalExponentReciprocityMainTheorem
statement:
theorem rationalExponentReciprocityMainTheorem
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    realFloorPowerSum
        (rationalExponent p q)
        n +
      realFloorPowerSum
        (rationalExponent q p)
        (realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n) =
      n *
          realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
        Nat.nthRoot q n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [
    rationalFloorPowerSum
  ] using
    rationalFloorPowerReciprocity
      p q n hp hq hpq

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalFloorPowerReciprocity_articleForm
statement:
theorem rationalFloorPowerReciprocity_articleForm
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n) =
      n *
          realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
        Nat.nthRoot p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    rationalFloorPowerSum p q n +
        rationalFloorPowerSum q p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n) =
      n *
          realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
        Nat.nthRoot q n :=
      rationalFloorPowerReciprocity
        p q n hp hq hpq
    _ =
      n *
          realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
        Nat.nthRoot p
          (realFloorPowerCutoff
            (rationalExponent p q)
            n) := by
      rw [

name: RoundedRootSums.rationalExponentReciprocityArticleTheorem
statement:
theorem rationalExponentReciprocityArticleTheorem
    (p q n : Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q) :
    realFloorPowerSum
        (rationalExponent p q)
        n +
      realFloorPowerSum
        (rationalExponent q p)
        (realFloorPowerCutoff
          (rationalExponent p q)
          n) =
      n *

            (rationalExponent p q)
            n +
