name: RoundedRootSums.sum_Icc_split_succ
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_split_succ
    {α : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : ℕ → α)
    (a b : ℕ)
    (h : a ≤ b + 1) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc a (b + 1), f k =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc a b, f k) + f (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top h f

name: RoundedRootSums.fullBlocks_formula
statement:
theorem fullBlocks_formula (m : Nat) :
    fullBlocks m =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m)
        (fun j => j * (2 * j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold fullBlocks
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact blockSum_formula j

name: RoundedRootSums.lastBlock_formula
statement:
theorem lastBlock_formula (m n : Nat) :
    lastBlock m n = (n - m ^ 2 + 1) * m
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_closed_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_closed_formula (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      rootIndex n * (n + 1) -
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun m => m ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocal_root_identity]
  have htotal :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun m => reciprocalCount n m) +
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun m => m ^ 2) =
      rootIndex n * (n + 1) := by
    calc
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
            (fun m => reciprocalCount n m) +
          Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
            (fun m => m ^ 2) =
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun m => reciprocalCount n m + m ^ 2) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ =
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun _ => n + 1) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro m hm
            have hm_le : m ≤ rootIndex n :=
              (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).2
            have hsq : m ^ 2 ≤ n := by
              apply (le_sqrt_iff_sq_le m n).1
              simpa [rootIndex] using hm_le
            unfold reciprocalCount
            omega
      _ = rootIndex n * (n + 1) := by
            simp [Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_explicit_formula (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      rootIndex n * (n + 1) -
        rootIndex n * (rootIndex n + 1) *
          (2 * rootIndex n + 1) / 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSum_closed_formula]
  rw [sum_squares_Icc_one]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_unfold
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k => nearestSqrt (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_floor
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_floor
    (k : Nat)
    (h : 2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k
proof:
:= by
  simp [nearestSqrt, h]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_succ
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_succ
    (k : Nat)
    (h : ¬ 2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [nearestSqrt, h]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k ∨
      nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h :
      2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1
  · left
    exact nearestSqrt_eq_floor k h
  · right
    exact nearestSqrt_eq_succ k h

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_le_nearestSqrt
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_nearestSqrt (k : Nat) :
    Nat.sqrt k ≤ nearestSqrt k
proof:
:= by
  rcases nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ k with h | h
  · rw [h]
  · rw [h]
    omega

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_le_sqrt_add_one
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_le_sqrt_add_one (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k ≤ Nat.sqrt k + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ k with h | h
  · rw [h]
    omega
  · rw [h]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_iff
statement:
theorem roundsUp_iff (k : Nat) :
    roundsUp k ↔
      ¬ (2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundsUp
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_sqrt_add_bonus
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_sqrt_add_bonus (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + nearestBonus k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h :
      2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1
  · rw [nearestSqrt_eq_floor k h]
    unfold nearestBonus
    simp [h]
  · rw [nearestSqrt_eq_succ k h]
    unfold nearestBonus
    simp [h]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonus_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem nearestBonus_eq_indicator (k : Nat) :
    nearestBonus k =
      if roundsUp k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestBonus roundsUp
  by_cases h :
      2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_unfold
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => nearestBonus (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (n k : Nat) :
    k ∈ roundedUpIndices n ↔
      k < n ∧ roundsUp (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [roundedUpIndices]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_not
statement:
theorem roundsUp_not (k : Nat) :
    ¬ roundsUp k ↔
      2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundsUp
  tauto

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_square_add_iff
statement:
theorem roundsUp_square_add_iff
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) ↔ m + 1 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundsUp
  have hsqrt : Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + t) = m := by
    apply Nat.sqrt_add_eq'
    omega
  rw [hsqrt]
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_square_add_iff'
statement:
theorem roundsUp_square_add_iff'
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) =
      (m + 1 ≤ t)
proof:
:= by
  apply propext
  exact roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff (m t : Nat) :
    t ∈ roundedUpOffsets m ↔
      t < 2 * m + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundedUpOffsets
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨ht, hup⟩
    have ht' : t ≤ 2 * m := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ht)
    constructor
    · exact Finset.mem_range.mp ht
    · exact (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht').mp hup
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨ht, hup⟩
    have ht' : t ≤ 2 * m := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ht)
    constructor
    · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr ht
    · exact (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht').mpr hup

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsets_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsets_eq_Icc (m : Nat) :
    roundedUpOffsets m = Finset.Icc (m + 1) (2 * m)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsets_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsets_card (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpOffsets m).card = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundedUpOffsets_eq_Icc]
  simp
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.not_roundsUp_square
statement:
theorem not_roundsUp_square (m : Nat) :
    ¬ roundsUp (m ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundsUp
  simp [Nat.sqrt_eq']

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_succ_split
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_succ_split
    (m : Nat) :
    roundedUpIndices ((m + 1) ^ 2) =
      roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2) ∪
        Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsets m)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hk
    have hk' :
        k < (m + 1) ^ 2 ∧ roundsUp (k + 1) :=
      (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff ((m + 1) ^ 2) k).mp hk
    rcases hk' with ⟨hklt, hup⟩
    by_cases hsmall : k < m ^ 2
    · left
      exact
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mpr
          ⟨hsmall, hup⟩
    · right
      let t : Nat := k + 1 - m ^ 2
      have hsquare :
          (m + 1) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + 2 * m + 1 := by
        ring
      have hmle : m ^ 2 ≤ k := by
        exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hsmall
      have ht_eq :
          m ^ 2 + t = k + 1 := by
        dsimp [t]
        omega
      have hk1le :
          k + 1 ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
        omega
      have hnot_square :
          ¬ roundsUp ((m + 1) ^ 2) :=
        not_roundsUp_square (m + 1)
      have hk1ne :
          k + 1 ≠ (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
        intro heq
        apply hnot_square
        rw [← heq]
        exact hup
      have hk1lt :
          k + 1 < (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
        omega
      have hklt' :
          k + 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + 2 * m := by
        rw [hsquare] at hk1lt
        omega
      have ht_le : t ≤ 2 * m := by
        dsimp [t]
        omega
      have hup_t :
          roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) := by
        rw [ht_eq]
        exact hup
      have ht_lower : m + 1 ≤ t :=
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht_le).mp hup_t
      have ht_mem :
          t ∈ roundedUpOffsets m := by
        apply (mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff m t).mpr
        constructor
        · omega
        · exact ht_lower
      refine ⟨t, ht_mem, ?_⟩
      dsimp [t]
      omega
  · intro hk
    rcases hk with hk | hk
    · have hk' :
          k < m ^ 2 ∧ roundsUp (k + 1) :=
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mp hk
      apply
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff ((m + 1) ^ 2) k).mpr
      constructor
      · have hsquare :
            (m + 1) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + 2 * m + 1 := by
          ring
        rw [hsquare]
        omega
      · exact hk'.2
    · rcases hk with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      have ht' :
          t < 2 * m + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ t :=
        (mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff m t).mp ht
      have ht_le : t ≤ 2 * m := by
        omega
      have hup_t :
          roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) :=
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht_le).mpr ht'.2
      apply
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff
          ((m + 1) ^ 2)
          (m ^ 2 + t - 1)).mpr
      constructor
      · have hsquare :
            (m + 1) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + 2 * m + 1 := by
          ring
        rw [hsquare]
        omega
      · have harg :
            m ^ 2 + t - 1 + 1 = m ^ 2 + t := by
          omega
        rw [harg]
        exact hup_t

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_succ_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_succ_card
    (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices ((m + 1) ^ 2)).card =
      (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundedUpIndices_square_succ_split]
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint
        (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2))
        (Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsets m)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro k hkOld hkNew
    have hklt : k < m ^ 2 :=
      (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mp hkOld |>.1
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hkNew with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have htLower : m + 1 ≤ t :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff m t).mp ht |>.2
    omega
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint]
  have himage :
      (Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsets m)).card =
        (roundedUpOffsets m).card := by
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have haLower : m + 1 ≤ a :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff m a).mp ha |>.2
    have hbLower : m + 1 ≤ b :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff m b).mp hb |>.2
    have haPos : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + a := by
      omega
    have hbPos : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + b := by
      omega
    have habSucc :
        (m ^ 2 + a - 1) + 1 =
          (m ^ 2 + b - 1) + 1 := by
      exact congrArg (fun x : Nat => x + 1) hab
    have habAdd :
        m ^ 2 + a = m ^ 2 + b := by
      calc
        m ^ 2 + a =
            (m ^ 2 + a - 1) + 1 := by
              exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel haPos).symm
        _ = (m ^ 2 + b - 1) + 1 := habSucc
        _ = m ^ 2 + b := by
              exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hbPos
    exact Nat.add_left_cancel habAdd
  rw [himage]
  rw [roundedUpOffsets_card]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_card_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_card_eq_sum_range (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m) (fun k => k)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      simp [roundedUpIndices]
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [roundedUpIndices_square_succ_card]
      rw [ih]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_card (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card =
      m * (m - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundedUpIndices_square_card_eq_sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_range_id m

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff
    (m r t : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    t ∈ roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r ↔
      t ≤ r ∧ m + 1 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundedUpOffsetsUpTo
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨htRange, htRounds⟩
    have htLeR : t ≤ r := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp
        (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
          Finset.mem_range.mp htRange)
    have htLe : t ≤ 2 * m := by
      omega
    constructor
    · exact htLeR
    · exact
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t htLe).mp htRounds
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨htLeR, htLower⟩
    have htLe : t ≤ 2 * m := by
      omega
    constructor
    · apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
      omega
    · exact
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t htLe).mpr htLower

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_card
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r).card = r - m
proof:
:= by
  have hset :
      roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r =
        Finset.Icc (m + 1) r := by
    ext t
    rw [mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r t hr]
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  rw [hset]
  simp

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_split
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_split
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r) =
      roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2) ∪
        Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  constructor
  · intro hk
    have hk' :
        k < m ^ 2 + r ∧ roundsUp (k + 1) :=
      (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2 + r) k).mp hk
    rcases hk' with ⟨hklt, hup⟩
    by_cases hsmall : k < m ^ 2
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      exact
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mpr
          ⟨hsmall, hup⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_union_right
      let t : Nat := k + 1 - m ^ 2
      have hmle : m ^ 2 ≤ k := by
        exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hsmall
      have ht_eq :
          m ^ 2 + t = k + 1 := by
        dsimp [t]
        omega
      have hk1le :
          k + 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + r := by
        omega
      have ht_le_r : t ≤ r := by
        dsimp [t]
        omega
      have ht_le : t ≤ 2 * m := by
        omega
      have hup_t :
          roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) := by
        rw [ht_eq]
        exact hup
      have ht_lower : m + 1 ≤ t :=
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht_le).mp hup_t
      have ht_mem :
          t ∈ roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r := by
        apply
          (mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r t hr).mpr
        exact ⟨ht_le_r, ht_lower⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨t, ht_mem, ?_⟩
      dsimp [t]
      omega
  · intro hk
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hk with hkOld | hkNew
    · have hk' :
          k < m ^ 2 ∧ roundsUp (k + 1) :=
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mp hkOld
      apply
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2 + r) k).mpr
      constructor
      · omega
      · exact hk'.2
    · rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hkNew with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      have ht' :
          t ≤ r ∧ m + 1 ≤ t :=
        (mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r t hr).mp ht
      have ht_le : t ≤ 2 * m := by
        omega
      have hup_t :
          roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) :=
        (roundsUp_square_add_iff m t ht_le).mpr ht'.2
      apply
        (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff
          (m ^ 2 + r)
          (m ^ 2 + t - 1)).mpr
      constructor
      · omega
      · have harg :
            m ^ 2 + t - 1 + 1 = m ^ 2 + t := by
          omega
        rw [harg]
        exact hup_t

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonus
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonus (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n +
        Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
          (fun k => nearestBonus (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestRootSum rootSum
  simp_rw [nearestSqrt_eq_sqrt_add_bonus]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n = rootSum n + nearestBonusSum n
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonus]
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n = (roundedUpIndices n).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestBonusSum roundedUpIndices
  simp_rw [nearestBonus_eq_indicator]
  exact
    (Finset.card_filter
      (fun k : Nat => roundsUp (k + 1))
      (Finset.range n)).symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_card
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_card (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n + (roundedUpIndices n).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum]
  rw [nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_card
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r)).card =
      (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card + (r - m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundedUpIndices_square_add_split m r hr]
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint
        (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2))
        (Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro k hkOld hkNew
    have hklt : k < m ^ 2 :=
      (mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (m ^ 2) k).mp hkOld |>.1
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hkNew with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have htLower : m + 1 ≤ t :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r t hr).mp ht |>.2
    omega
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint]
  have himage :
      (Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r)).card =
        (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r).card := by
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have haLower : m + 1 ≤ a :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r a hr).mp ha |>.2
    have hbLower : m + 1 ≤ b :=
      (mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff m r b hr).mp hb |>.2
    have haPos : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + a := by
      omega
    have hbPos : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 + b := by
      omega
    have habSucc :
        (m ^ 2 + a - 1) + 1 =
          (m ^ 2 + b - 1) + 1 := by
      exact congrArg (fun x : Nat => x + 1) hab
    have habAdd :
        m ^ 2 + a = m ^ 2 + b := by
      calc
        m ^ 2 + a =
            (m ^ 2 + a - 1) + 1 := by
              exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel haPos).symm
        _ = (m ^ 2 + b - 1) + 1 := habSucc
        _ = m ^ 2 + b := by
              exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hbPos
    exact Nat.add_left_cancel habAdd
  rw [himage]
  rw [roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_card m r hr]

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_card_explicit
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_card_explicit
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r)).card =
      m * (m - 1) / 2 + (r - m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundedUpIndices_square_add_card m r hr]
  rw [roundedUpIndices_square_card]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_formula
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n =
      Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)
proof:
:= by
  let m : Nat := Nat.sqrt n
  let r : Nat := n - m ^ 2
  have hm_sq_le : m ^ 2 ≤ n := by
    apply (Nat.le_sqrt').mp
    simp [m]
  have hn_lt : n < (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
    exact
      ((Nat.eq_sqrt').mp
        (by rfl : m = Nat.sqrt n)).2
  have hsquare :
      (m + 1) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + 2 * m + 1 := by
    ring
  have hr : r ≤ 2 * m := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [hsquare] at hn_lt
    omega
  have hn_decomp :
      m ^ 2 + r = n := by
    dsimp [r]
    omega
  calc
    nearestBonusSum n =
        (roundedUpIndices n).card :=
      nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices n
    _ = (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r)).card := by
      rw [hn_decomp]
    _ = m * (m - 1) / 2 + (r - m) :=
      roundedUpIndices_square_add_card_explicit m r hr
    _ =
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
          (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n) := by
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_formula
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n +
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum]
  rw [nearestBonusSum_formula]
  simp [Nat.add_assoc]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_explicit_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      Nat.sqrt n * (n + 1) -
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n + 1) *
          (2 * Nat.sqrt n + 1) / 6 +
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearestRootSum_formula]
  rw [rootSum_explicit_formula]
  simp [rootIndex]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoot_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoot_nonneg
    (q k : Nat) :
    0 ≤ shiftedRealRoot q k
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedRealRoot
  exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedArgument_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedArgument_nonneg
    (q a b k : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    0 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedArgument q a b k
proof:
:= by
  have hbReal : (0 : Real) < (b : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have hshift :
      0 ≤ (a : Real) / (b : Real) := by
    exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (le_of_lt hbReal)
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedArgument
  exact add_nonneg
    (shiftedRealRoot_nonneg q k)
    hshift

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealBase_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedRealBase_nonneg
    (a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    0 ≤
      (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
        (a : Real) / (b : Real))
proof:
:= by
  have hbReal : (0 : Real) < (b : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have haReal : (a : Real) < (b : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast ha
  have hdiv :
      (a : Real) / (b : Real) < 1 := by
    exact (div_lt_one hbReal).2 haReal
  have hm :
      (1 : Real) ≤ ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m)
  linarith

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealBase_le_root_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedRealBase_le_root_iff
    (q a b k m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
          (a : Real) / (b : Real) ≤
        shiftedRealRoot q k) ↔
      ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
          (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ^ q ≤
        (k : Real))
proof:
:= by
  have hqReal : (0 : Real) < (q : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hbase :
      0 ≤
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
          (a : Real) / (b : Real)) :=
    shiftedRealBase_nonneg a b m hb ha
  have hkReal : (0 : Real) ≤ (k : Real) := by
    positivity
  unfold shiftedRealRoot
  simpa using
    (Real.le_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos
      hbase hkReal hqReal)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff
    (q a b k m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    m + 1 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k ↔
      ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
          (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ^ q ≤
        (k : Real))
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedValue
  rw [Nat.le_floor_iff
    (shiftedRealRoundedArgument_nonneg
      q a b k hb)]
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedArgument
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hbase :
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
            (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ≤
          shiftedRealRoot q k := by
      linarith
    exact
      (shiftedRealBase_le_root_iff
        q a b k m hq hb ha).mp hbase
  · intro hpow
    have hbase :
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
            (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ≤
          shiftedRealRoot q k :=
      (shiftedRealBase_le_root_iff
        q a b k m hq hb ha).mpr hpow
    linarith

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealPower_le_iff_ratPower
statement:
theorem shiftedRealPower_le_iff_ratPower
    (q a b k m : Nat) :
    ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
          (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ^ q ≤
        (k : Real)) ↔
      ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q ≤
        (k : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [
    Rat.cast_pow,
    Rat.cast_sub,
    Rat.cast_div,
    Rat.cast_natCast
  ] using
    (Rat.cast_le
      (K := Real)
      (p :=
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q))
      (q := (k : Rat)))

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff_ratPower
statement:
theorem shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff_ratPower
    (q a b k m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    m + 1 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k ↔
      ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q ≤
        (k : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    m + 1 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k ↔
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) -
            (a : Real) / (b : Real)) ^ q ≤
          (k : Real)) :=
      shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff
        q a b k m hq hb ha
    _ ↔
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
            (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q ≤
          (k : Rat)) :=
      shiftedRealPower_le_iff_ratPower
        q a b k m

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_of_le
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_of_le
    (q a b k t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (ht :
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k ≤ t) :
    shiftedPowerCount q a b k t =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerCount
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.range t).filter (fun m =>
          ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
              (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat)) =
        Finset.range
          (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k) := by
    ext m
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro hm
      have hmle :
          m + 1 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k :=
        (shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff_ratPower
          q a b k m hq hb ha).mpr hm.2
      exact Nat.lt_of_succ_le hmle
    · intro hm
      have hmt : m < t :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hm ht
      have hmle :
          m + 1 ≤ shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k :=
        Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hm
      have hpow :
          ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
              (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat) :=
        (shiftedLevel_le_realRoundedValue_iff_ratPower
          q a b k m hq hb ha).mp hmle
      exact ⟨hmt, hpow⟩
  rw [hfilter]
  simp

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerCount_at_realRoundedValue
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerCount_at_realRoundedValue
    (q a b k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerCount q a b k
        (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k) =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k
proof:
:= by
  exact shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_of_le
    q a b k
      (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k)
      hq hb ha
      (Nat.le_refl _)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoot_le_nat
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoot_le_nat
    (q k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    shiftedRealRoot q k ≤ (k : Real)
proof:
:= by
  have hqReal : (0 : Real) < (q : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hkReal : (0 : Real) ≤ (k : Real) := by
    positivity
  have hkpowNat : k ≤ k ^ q := by
    exact Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hq) k
  have hkpowReal :
      (k : Real) ≤ (k : Real) ^ q := by
    exact_mod_cast hkpowNat
  unfold shiftedRealRoot
  apply
    (Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos
      hkReal hkReal hqReal).2
  simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using hkpowReal

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedValue_le_succ
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedValue_le_succ
    (q a b k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k ≤ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbReal : (0 : Real) < (b : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have haReal : (a : Real) < (b : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast ha
  have hshift :
      (a : Real) / (b : Real) < 1 := by
    exact (div_lt_one hbReal).2 haReal
  have hroot :
      shiftedRealRoot q k ≤ (k : Real) :=
    shiftedRealRoot_le_nat q k hq
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedValue
  apply Nat.floor_le_of_le
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedArgument
  have hlt :
      shiftedRealRoot q k +
          (a : Real) / (b : Real) <
        (k : Real) + 1 := by
    linarith
  simpa using le_of_lt hlt

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_commonBound
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_commonBound
    (q a b n k : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    shiftedPowerCount q a b k (n + 1) =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b k
proof:
:= by
  exact shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_of_le
    q a b k (n + 1) hq hb ha
    (le_trans
      (shiftedRealRoundedValue_le_succ
        q a b k hq hb ha)
      (Nat.succ_le_succ hk))

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedSum_eq_powerRoundedSum
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedSum_eq_powerRoundedSum
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedRealRoundedSum
  unfold shiftedPowerRoundedSum shiftedPowerCountSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n :=
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
  exact
    (shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_commonBound
      q a b n k hq hb ha hkn).symm

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedMaxLevel_eq_realRoundedValue
statement:
theorem shiftedMaxLevel_eq_realRoundedValue
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedMaxLevel q a b n =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedMaxLevel
  exact shiftedPowerCount_eq_realRoundedValue_commonBound
    q a b n n hq hb ha (Nat.le_refl n)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedSum_explicit_formula
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b
          (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
        shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n :=
      shiftedRealRoundedSum_eq_powerRoundedSum
        q a b n hq hb ha
    _ =
        shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) -
          shiftedThresholdSum q a b
            (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) :=
      shiftedPowerRoundedSum_explicit_formula
        q a b n hb ha
    _ =
        shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
          shiftedThresholdSum q a b
            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) := by
      rw [shiftedMaxLevel_eq_realRoundedValue
        q a b n hq hb ha]

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_const
statement:
theorem sum_const
    (n c : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun _ => c) = n * c
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_id_range
statement:
theorem sum_id_range
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i => i) =
      n * (n - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_range_id n

name: RoundedRootSums.card_range
statement:
theorem card_range
    (n : Nat) :
    (Finset.range n).card = n
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_odd_range
statement:
theorem sum_odd_range
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun i => 2 * i + 1) =
      n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp [ih]
      ring

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_range_succ
statement:
theorem sum_squares_range_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) + n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: RoundedRootSums.six_mul_sum_squares_range_succ
statement:
theorem six_mul_sum_squares_range_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    6 * Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [Nat.mul_add]
      rw [ih]
      ring

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_range_closed
statement:
theorem sum_squares_range_closed
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 6
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_div_of_mul_eq_right
  · norm_num
  · exact six_mul_sum_squares_range_succ n

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_Icc_eq_range
statement:
theorem sum_squares_Icc_eq_range
    (r : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 r)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (r + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [ih]

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_Icc_one
statement:
theorem sum_squares_Icc_one
    (r : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 r)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      r * (r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) / 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_squares_Icc_eq_range]
  exact sum_squares_range_closed r

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_split_at
statement:
theorem rootSum_split_at
    (m n : Nat)
    (h : m ≤ n) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m)
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1)) +
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (n - m))
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (m + k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootSum
  have hn : n = m + (n - m) := by
    omega
  rw [hn]
  simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using
    (Finset.sum_range_add
      (f := fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1))
      m
      (n - m))

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotient_add_residue
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotient_add_residue
    (q a b m : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerDenominator q b *
        (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m /
          shiftedPowerDenominator q b) +
      shiftedPowerResidue q a b m =
    shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
    (shiftedPowerResidue_add_denominator_mul_div
      q a b m)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotientSum_add_residueSum
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotientSum_add_residueSum
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerDenominator q b *
        shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t +
      shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t =
    shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerQuotientSum
  unfold shiftedPowerResidueSum
  unfold shiftedPowerNumeratorSum
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  exact shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotient_add_residue
    q a b (m + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_sub_residueSum
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_sub_residueSum
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t -
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t =
      shiftedPowerDenominator q b *
        shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotientSum_add_residueSum
      q a b t
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerQuotientSum_eq_sub_residue_div
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerQuotientSum_eq_sub_residue_div
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t =
      (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t -
          shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t) /
        shiftedPowerDenominator q b
proof:
:= by
  have hD :
      shiftedPowerDenominator q b ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt
      (shiftedPowerDenominator_pos q b hb)
  rw [shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_sub_residueSum]
  simp [hD]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumerator_cast_int
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumerator_cast_int
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m : Int) =
      shiftedPowerNumeratorInt q a b m
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedPowerNumerator, shiftedPowerNumeratorInt,
    Nat.cast_sub ham]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorInt_eq_binomialSum
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorInt_eq_binomialSum
    (q a b m : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerNumeratorInt q a b m =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
        shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b m j)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [shiftedPowerNumeratorInt, shiftedPowerBinomialTerm] using
    (sub_pow
      ((b : Int) * (m : Int))
      (a : Int)
      q)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_int
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_int
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Int) =
      shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerNumeratorSum
  unfold shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum
  rw [Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  apply shiftedPowerNumerator_cast_int
  calc
    a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
    _ = b * 1 := by simp
    _ ≤ b * (m + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialDoubleSum
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialDoubleSum
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
          shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b (m + 1) j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  exact shiftedPowerNumeratorInt_eq_binomialSum
    q a b (m + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialSum_swapped
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialSum_swapped
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
        Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
          shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b (m + 1) j))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t =
        Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
          Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
            shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b (m + 1) j)) :=
      shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialDoubleSum
        q a b t
    _ =
        Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
          Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
            shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b (m + 1) j)) := by
      exact Finset.sum_comm

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerBinomialTerm_eq_coefficient_mul_power
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerBinomialTerm_eq_coefficient_mul_power
    (q a b m j : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b m j =
      shiftedPowerBinomialCoefficient q a b j *
        (m : Int) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerBinomialTerm
  unfold shiftedPowerBinomialCoefficient
  rw [mul_pow]
  ring

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerBinomialInnerSum_eq_coefficient_mul_powerSum
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerBinomialInnerSum_eq_coefficient_mul_powerSum
    (q a b t j : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedPowerBinomialTerm q a b (m + 1) j) =
      shiftedPowerBinomialCoefficient q a b j *
        positivePowerSumInt j t
proof:
:= by
  unfold positivePowerSumInt
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  exact shiftedPowerBinomialTerm_eq_coefficient_mul_power
    q a b (m + 1) j

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_coefficientPowerSums
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_coefficientPowerSums
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (q + 1)) (fun j =>
        shiftedPowerBinomialCoefficient q a b j *
          positivePowerSumInt j t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_binomialSum_swapped]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  exact
    shiftedPowerBinomialInnerSum_eq_coefficient_mul_powerSum
      q a b t j

name: RoundedRootSums.positivePowerSumInt_cast_rat
statement:
theorem positivePowerSumInt_cast_rat
    (j t : Nat) :
    (positivePowerSumInt j t : Rat) =
      positivePowerSumRat j t
proof:
:= by
  simp [positivePowerSumInt, positivePowerSumRat]

name: RoundedRootSums.positivePowerSumRat_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem positivePowerSumRat_eq_bernoulli
    (j t : Nat) :
    positivePowerSumRat j t =
      positivePowerSumBernoulli j t
proof:
:= by
  unfold positivePowerSumRat
  unfold positivePowerSumBernoulli
  simpa [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.add_comm] using
    (sum_Ico_pow t j)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
    (q a b t : Nat) :
    (shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t : Rat) =
      shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli q a b t
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_eq_coefficientPowerSums]
  unfold shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli
  rw [Int.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  rw [Int.cast_mul]
  rw [positivePowerSumInt_cast_rat]
  rw [positivePowerSumRat_eq_bernoulli]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Rat) =
      shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli q a b t
proof:
:= by
  have hInt :
      (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Int) =
        shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t :=
    shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_int q a b t ha
  calc
    (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Rat) =
        (shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum q a b t : Rat) := by
      exact_mod_cast hInt
    _ = shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli q a b t :=
      shiftedPowerNumeratorIntSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
        q a b t

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerQuotientSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerQuotientSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) =
      shiftedPowerQuotientBernoulli q a b t
proof:
:= by
  have hNat :=
    shiftedPowerDenominator_mul_quotientSum_add_residueSum
      q a b t
  have hRat :
      (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat) *
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) +
        (shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t : Rat) =
      (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hNat
  have hDnat :
      shiftedPowerDenominator q b ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt
      (shiftedPowerDenominator_pos q b hb)
  have hD :
      (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hDnat
  have hBern :
      (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Rat) =
        shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli q a b t :=
    shiftedPowerNumeratorSum_cast_rat_eq_bernoulli
      q a b t ha
  unfold shiftedPowerQuotientBernoulli
  apply (eq_div_iff hD).2
  calc
    (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) *
          (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat) =
        (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat) *
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) := by
      ring
    _ =
        (shiftedPowerNumeratorSum q a b t : Rat) -
          (shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t : Rat) := by
      linarith
    _ =
        shiftedPowerNumeratorBernoulli q a b t -
          (shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t : Rat) := by
      rw [hBern]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidueSum_period_add
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidueSum_period_add
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
        (shiftedResiduePeriod q b + t) =
      shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerResidueSum
  unfold shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _hr
  simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
    (shiftedPowerResidue_add_period
      q a b r hq ha)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidueSum_mul_period_add
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidueSum_mul_period_add
    (q a b s r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
        (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) =
      s * shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b r
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ s ih =>
      calc
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
            (Nat.succ s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) =
          shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
            (shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r)) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Nat.succ_mul]
            ac_rfl
        _ =
          shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) :=
          shiftedPowerResidueSum_period_add
            q a b
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r)
              hq ha
        _ =
          shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
            (s * shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
              shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b r) := by
            rw [ih]
        _ =
          Nat.succ s *
              shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b r := by
            rw [Nat.succ_mul]
            ac_rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidueSum_div_mod
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidueSum_div_mod
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t =
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
          shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
          (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
          shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
        t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b = t := by
    calc
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
            shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
          t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b =
        t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
          shiftedResiduePeriod q b *
            (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) := by
          ac_rfl
      _ = t :=
        Nat.mod_add_div t (shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
  calc
    shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b t =
        shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
          ((t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
              shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
            t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b) := by
      rw [hdecomp]
    _ =
        (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
            shiftedPowerResiduePeriodSum q a b +
          shiftedPowerResidueSum q a b
            (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b) :=
      shiftedPowerResidueSum_mul_period_add
        q a b
          (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
          (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
          hq ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidueSum_eq_periodicForm
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidueSum_eq_periodicForm
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)

      shiftedPowerResiduePeriodicForm q a b t
proof:

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerQuotientSum_cast_rat_eq_periodicBernoulli
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerQuotientSum_cast_rat_eq_periodicBernoulli
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) =
      shiftedPowerQuotientBernoulliPeriodic q a b t
proof:

  calc
    (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t : Rat) =

        q a b t hb ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCount_eq_powerCount
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCount_eq_powerCount
    (q a b k t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedLevelCount q a b k t =
      ((Finset.range t).filter (fun m =>
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
            (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat))).card
proof:
:= by
  have ham :
      ∀ m : Nat, a ≤ b * (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    calc
      a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
      _ = b * 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ b * (m + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))
  unfold shiftedLevelCount
  refine congrArg Finset.card ?_
  ext m
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1,
      (shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
        q a b (m + 1) k hb (ham m)).mp h.2⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1,
      (shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
        q a b (m + 1) k hb (ham m)).mpr h.2⟩

theorem shiftedRoundedValueUpTo_eq_powerCount

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerCount_mono
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerCount_mono
    (q a b k₁ k₂ t : Nat)
    (hk : k₁ ≤ k₂) :
    shiftedPowerCount q a b k₁ t ≤
      shiftedPowerCount q a b k₂ t
proof:
:= by
  have hkRat : (k₁ : Rat) ≤ (k₂ : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hk
  unfold shiftedPowerCount
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro m hm
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢

    q a b k n (n + 1) hk

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedBase_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedBase_nonneg
    (a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (0 : Rat) ≤
      ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)
proof:
:= by
  have hbRat : (0 : Rat) < (b : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have haRat : (a : Rat) < (b : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast ha
  have hdiv :
      (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) < 1 := by
    exact (div_lt_one hbRat).2 haRat
  have hm :
      (1 : Rat) ≤ ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m)
  linarith

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPower_mono_level
statement:
theorem shiftedPower_mono_level
    (q a b m₁ m₂ : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂) :
    ((((m₁ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤
      ((((m₂ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmRat :
      ((m₁ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ≤
        ((m₂ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ hm
  have hbase :
      ((m₁ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) ≤
        ((m₂ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) := by
    exact sub_le_sub_right hmRat _
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀
    (shiftedBase_nonneg a b m₁ hb ha)
    hbase q

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPower_reached_downward
statement:
theorem shiftedPower_reached_downward
    (q a b k m₁ m₂ : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂)
    (hreached :
      ((((m₂ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat)) :
    ((((m₁ + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat)
proof:
:= by
  exact le_trans
    (shiftedPower_mono_level
      q a b m₁ m₂ hb ha hm)
    hreached

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerCount_eq_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerCount_eq_of_cutoff
    (q a b n k t : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedPowerCount q a b k (n + 1) =
      shiftedPowerCount q a b k t
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcut with ⟨htn, hcut⟩
  unfold shiftedPowerCount
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  ext m
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro hm
    have hkRat : (k : Rat) ≤ (n : Rat) := by
      exact_mod_cast hk
    have hreachedN :
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
            (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat) :=
      le_trans hm.2 hkRat
    have hmt : m < t :=
      (hcut m hm.1).mp hreachedN
    exact ⟨hmt, hm.2⟩
  · intro hm
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hm.1 htn, hm.2⟩

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_of_cutoff
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n =
        shiftedPowerCountSum q a b n t := by
      unfold shiftedPowerRoundedSum shiftedPowerCountSum
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hkn : k ≤ n :=
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
      exact shiftedPowerCount_eq_of_cutoff
        q a b n k t hkn hcut
    _ = shiftedInversionSum q a b n t :=
      shiftedPowerCountSum_eq_inversionSum
        q a b n t hb ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPower_reached_iff_lt_maxLevel
statement:
theorem shiftedPower_reached_iff_lt_maxLevel
    (q a b n m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hmn : m < n + 1) :
    (((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat)) ↔
      m < shiftedMaxLevel q a b n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmreach
    have hsubset :
        Finset.range (m + 1) ⊆
          (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun j =>
            (((((j + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
                (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat))) := by
      intro j hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
      have hjm : j ≤ m :=
        Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj
      have hjn : j < n + 1 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hjm hmn
      have hjreach :
          (((((j + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
              (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat)) :=
        shiftedPower_reached_downward
          q a b n j m hb ha hjm hmreach
      exact ⟨hjn, hjreach⟩
    have hcard :=
      Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    have hsucc :
        m + 1 ≤ shiftedMaxLevel q a b n := by
      simpa [shiftedMaxLevel, shiftedPowerCount] using hcard
    exact Nat.lt_of_succ_le hsucc
  · intro hmmax
    by_contra hmreach
    have hsubset :
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun j =>
            (((((j + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
                (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat))) ⊆
          Finset.range m := by
      intro j hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      by_contra hjm
      have hmj : m ≤ j :=
        Nat.le_of_not_gt hjm
      apply hmreach
      exact shiftedPower_reached_downward
        q a b n m j hb ha hmj hj.2
    have hcard :=
      Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    have hle :
        shiftedMaxLevel q a b n ≤ m := by
      simpa [shiftedMaxLevel, shiftedPowerCount] using hcard
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hmmax

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    IsShiftedCutoff
      q a b n (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hsubset :
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun m =>
            (((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
                (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat))) ⊆
          Finset.range (n + 1) :=
      Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have hcard :=
      Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    simpa [shiftedMaxLevel, shiftedPowerCount] using hcard
  · intro m hm
    exact shiftedPower_reached_iff_lt_maxLevel
      q a b n m hb ha hm

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n
        (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  exact shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_of_cutoff
    q a b n (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) hb ha
      (shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff q a b n hb ha)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_powerRoundedSum
statement:
theorem shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_powerRoundedSum
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRoundedSumBounded q a b n =
      shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedRoundedSumBounded q a b n =
        shiftedRoundedSumUpTo q a b n (n + 1) :=
      shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_upTo q a b n
    _ = shiftedPowerCountSum q a b n (n + 1) :=
      shiftedRoundedSumUpTo_eq_shiftedPowerCountSum
        q a b n (n + 1) hb ha
    _ = shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n := by
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
statement:
theorem shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRoundedSumBounded q a b n =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n
        (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedRoundedSumBounded q a b n =
        shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n :=
      shiftedRoundedSumBounded_eq_powerRoundedSum
        q a b n hb ha
    _ = shiftedInversionSum q a b n
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) :=
      shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
        q a b n hb ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_le_n_of_lt_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_le_n_of_lt_cutoff
    (q a b n t m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : m < t)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcut with ⟨htn, hlevels⟩
  have hmn : m < n + 1 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hm htn
  have hpow :
      (((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
          (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (n : Rat)) :=
    (hlevels m hmn).mpr hm
  have ham : a ≤ b * (m + 1) := by
    calc
      a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
      _ = b * 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ b * (m + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))
  exact
    (shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
      q a b (m + 1) n hb ham).mpr hpow

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n t +
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b t =
      t * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedInversionSum shiftedThresholdSum
  calc
    Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1)) +
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1))
        =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        (n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1)) +
          shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1)) := by
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_add_distrib
    _ = Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun _ => n + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      apply Nat.sub_add_cancel
      exact le_trans
        (shiftedThresholdNat_le_n_of_lt_cutoff
          q a b n t m hb ha
            (Finset.mem_range.mp hm) hcut)
        (Nat.le_succ n)
    _ = t * (n + 1) := by
      simp

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n t =
      t * (n + 1) - shiftedThresholdSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
      q a b n t hb ha hcut
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_maxLevel
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_maxLevel
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n
        (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) =
      shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) -
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  exact shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
    q a b n (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) hb ha
      (shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff q a b n hb ha)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerRoundedSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerRoundedSum_explicit_formula
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) -
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedPowerRoundedSum q a b n =
        shiftedInversionSum q a b n
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) :=
      shiftedPowerRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum_maxLevel
        q a b n hb ha
    _ = shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) -
          shiftedThresholdSum q a b
            (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) :=
      shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_maxLevel
        q a b n hb ha

name: RoundedRootSums.finiteIncidenceSum_comm
statement:
theorem finiteIncidenceSum_comm
    {ι κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι)
    (t : Finset κ)
    (p : ι → κ → Prop) :
    Finset.sum s
        (fun i =>
          Finset.sum t
            (fun j =>
              @ite Nat
                (p i j)
                (Classical.propDecidable (p i j))
                1
                0)) =
      Finset.sum t
        (fun j =>
          Finset.sum s
            (fun i =>
              @ite Nat
                (p i j)
                (Classical.propDecidable (p i j))
                1
                0))
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRowSum_eq_levelSum
statement:
theorem realShiftRowSum_eq_levelSum
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          realShiftRowCount α θ n k) =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n))
        (fun m =>
          realShiftLevelCount α θ n m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold
    realShiftRowCount
    realShiftLevelCount
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_Icc_indicator_le
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_indicator_le
    (a B : Nat)
    (hAB : a ≤ B) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 B)
        (fun m =>
          if m ≤ a then (1 : Nat) else 0) =
      a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.Icc 1 B).filter
          (fun m => m ≤ a) =
        Finset.Icc 1 a := by
    ext m
    simp only [
      Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_Icc
    ]
    omega
  rw [hfilter]
  calc
    (Finset.Icc 1 a).card =
        a + 1 - 1 :=
      Nat.card_Icc 1 a
    _ = a :=
      Nat.add_sub_cancel_right a 1

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRowCount_eq_roundedValue
statement:
theorem realShiftRowCount_eq_roundedValue
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n k : Nat)
    (hk :
      realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ≤
        realShiftMaxLevel α θ n) :
    realShiftRowCount α θ n k =
      realShiftRoundedValue α θ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold
    realShiftRowCount
    realShiftIncidence
  exact
    sum_Icc_indicator_le
      (realShiftRoundedValue α θ k)
      (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n)
      hk

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum_of_rowBound
statement:
theorem realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum_of_rowBound
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hrow :
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n,
        realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ≤
          realShiftMaxLevel α θ n) :
    realShiftRoundedSum α θ n =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n))
        (fun m =>
          realShiftLevelCount α θ n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← realShiftRowSum_eq_levelSum]
  unfold realShiftRoundedSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact
    (realShiftRowCount_eq_roundedValue
      α θ n k
      (hrow k hk)).symm

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftPower_le_of_le
statement:
theorem realShiftPower_le_of_le
    (α : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (k n : Nat)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    realShiftPower α k ≤
      realShiftPower α n
proof:
:= by
  unfold realShiftPower
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
  · exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.zero_le k)
  · exact_mod_cast hkn
  · exact hα.le

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRoundedValue_le_of_le
statement:
theorem realShiftRoundedValue_le_of_le
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (k n : Nat)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ≤
      realShiftRoundedValue α θ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold realShiftRoundedValue
  apply Nat.floor_le_floor
  gcongr
  exact
    realShiftPower_le_of_le
      α hα k n hkn

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum
statement:
theorem realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α) :
    realShiftRoundedSum α θ n =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n))
        (fun m =>
          realShiftLevelCount α θ n m)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum_of_rowBound
      α θ n
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n :=
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
  simpa [realShiftMaxLevel] using
    realShiftRoundedValue_le_of_le
      α θ hα k n hkn

name: RoundedRootSums.le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff
statement:
theorem le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (k m : Nat)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ↔
      (m : ℝ) ≤ realShiftPower α k + θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold realShiftRoundedValue
  exact
    Nat.le_floor_iff'
      (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftLevelReal_iff_dualPower_le
statement:
theorem realShiftLevelReal_iff_dualPower_le
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (k m : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    (m : ℝ) ≤ realShiftPower α k + θ ↔
      Real.rpow
          ((m : ℝ) - θ)
          α⁻¹ ≤
        (k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmOneNat :
      1 ≤ m := by
    omega
  have hmOne :
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hmOneNat
  have hbase :
      0 ≤ (m : ℝ) - θ := by
    linarith
  have hkNonneg :
      0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hpowIff :
      Real.rpow
          ((m : ℝ) - θ)
          α⁻¹ ≤
        (k : ℝ) ↔
      (m : ℝ) - θ ≤
        Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α := by
    exact
      Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos
        hbase
        hkNonneg
        hα
  unfold realShiftPower
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hpowIff.mpr
    linarith
  · intro h
    have hlevel :
        (m : ℝ) - θ ≤
          Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α :=
      hpowIff.mp h
    linarith

name: RoundedRootSums.le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff_dualCeil_le
statement:
theorem le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff_dualCeil_le
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (k m : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ↔
      realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ↔
        (m : ℝ) ≤
          realShiftPower α k + θ :=
      le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff
        α θ k m hm
    _ ↔
        Real.rpow
            ((m : ℝ) - θ)
            α⁻¹ ≤
          (k : ℝ) :=
      realShiftLevelReal_iff_dualPower_le
        α θ k m hα hθ hm
    _ ↔
        realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k := by
      unfold realShiftDualCeil
      symm
      exact Nat.ceil_le

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftDualCeil_pos
statement:
theorem realShiftDualCeil_pos
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (m : Nat)
    (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    0 < realShiftDualCeil α θ m
proof:
:= by
  have hmOneNat :
      1 ≤ m := by
    omega
  have hmOne :
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hmOneNat
  have hbasePos :
      0 < (m : ℝ) - θ := by
    linarith
  unfold realShiftDualCeil
  rw [
    Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le,
    zero_add,
    Nat.one_le_ceil_iff
  ]
  exact
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
      hbasePos
      α⁻¹

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_Icc_indicator_ge
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_indicator_ge
    (c n : Nat)
    (hc : 0 < c) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          if c ≤ k then (1 : Nat) else 0) =
      n + 1 - c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcOne :
      1 ≤ c := by
    omega
  have hsumCard :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if c ≤ k then (1 : Nat) else 0) =
        ((Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k => c ≤ k)).card := by
    induction (Finset.Icc 1 n) using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        simp
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
        by_cases hca : c ≤ a <;>
          simp_all
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k => c ≤ k) =
        Finset.Icc c n := by
    ext k
    simp only [
      Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_Icc
    ]
    omega
  calc
    Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if c ≤ k then (1 : Nat) else 0) =
        ((Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
          (fun k => c ≤ k)).card :=
      hsumCard
    _ =
        (Finset.Icc c n).card := by
      rw [hfilter]
    _ =
        n + 1 - c :=
      Nat.card_Icc c n

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftLevelCount_eq
statement:
theorem realShiftLevelCount_eq
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n m : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    realShiftLevelCount α θ n m =
      n + 1 -
        realShiftDualCeil α θ m
proof:
:= by
  have hdualPos :
      0 < realShiftDualCeil α θ m :=
    realShiftDualCeil_pos
      α θ m hθ hm
  unfold
    realShiftLevelCount
    realShiftIncidence
  calc
    Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k then
              (1 : Nat)
            else
              0) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            if realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k then
              (1 : Nat)
            else
              0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _hk
      have hiff :
          m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k ↔
            realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k :=
        le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff_dualCeil_le
          α θ k m hα hθ hm
      by_cases hlevel :
          m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α θ k
      · have hdual :
            realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k :=
          hiff.mp hlevel
        simp [hlevel, hdual]
      · have hdual :
            ¬ realShiftDualCeil α θ m ≤ k := by
          intro h
          exact hlevel (hiff.mpr h)
        simp [hlevel, hdual]
    _ =
        n + 1 -
          realShiftDualCeil α θ m :=
      sum_Icc_indicator_ge
        (realShiftDualCeil α θ m)
        n
        hdualPos

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftLevelSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem realShiftLevelSum_eq_inversionSum
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ < 1) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n))
        (fun m =>
          realShiftLevelCount α θ n m) =
      realShiftInversionSum α θ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold realShiftInversionSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  have hmPos :
      0 < m :=
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1
  exact
    realShiftLevelCount_eq
      α θ n m hα hθ hmPos

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem realShiftRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ < 1) :
    realShiftRoundedSum α θ n =
      realShiftInversionSum α θ n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    realShiftRoundedSum α θ n =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc
            1
            (realShiftMaxLevel α θ n))
          (fun m =>
            realShiftLevelCount α θ n m) :=
      realShiftRoundedSum_eq_levelSum
        α θ n hα
    _ =
        realShiftInversionSum α θ n :=
      realShiftLevelSum_eq_inversionSum
        α θ n hα hθ

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftExactInversion
statement:
theorem realShiftExactInversion
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          ⌊Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α + θ⌋₊) =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α + θ⌋₊)
        (fun m =>
          n + 1 -
            ⌈Real.rpow
                ((m : ℝ) - θ)
                α⁻¹⌉₊)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [
    realShiftRoundedSum,
    realShiftRoundedValue,
    realShiftPower,
    realShiftInversionSum,
    realShiftMaxLevel,
    realShiftDualCeil
  ] using
    realShiftRoundedSum_eq_inversionSum
      α θ n hα hθ.2

name: RoundedRootSums.realFloorPowerSum_eq_dualSum
statement:
theorem realFloorPowerSum_eq_dualSum
    (α : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α) :
    realFloorPowerSum α n =
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realFloorPowerCutoff α n))
        (fun m =>
          n + 1 -
            ⌈Real.rpow
                (m : ℝ)
                α⁻¹⌉₊)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor <;> norm_num
  simpa [
    realFloorPowerSum,
    realFloorPowerCutoff
  ] using
    realShiftExactInversion
      α 0 n hα hzero

name: RoundedRootSums.realDualCeil_le_of_mem_cutoff
statement:
theorem realDualCeil_le_of_mem_cutoff
    (α : ℝ)
    (n m : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hm :
      m ∈ Finset.Icc
        1
        (realFloorPowerCutoff α n)) :
    ⌈Real.rpow
        (m : ℝ)
        α⁻¹⌉₊ ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  have hmPos :
      0 < m :=
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1
  have hmUpper :
      m ≤ realFloorPowerCutoff α n :=
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).2
  have hlevel :
      m ≤ realShiftRoundedValue α 0 n := by
    simpa [
      realFloorPowerCutoff,
      realShiftRoundedValue,
      realShiftPower
    ] using hmUpper
  have hdual :
      realShiftDualCeil α 0 m ≤ n :=
    (le_realShiftRoundedValue_iff_dualCeil_le
      α 0 n m
      hα
      (by norm_num)
      hmPos).mp hlevel
  simpa [realShiftDualCeil] using hdual

name: RoundedRootSums.realInversionTerm_add_dualCeil
statement:
theorem realInversionTerm_add_dualCeil
    (α : ℝ)
    (n m : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hm :
      m ∈ Finset.Icc
        1
        (realFloorPowerCutoff α n)) :
    (n + 1 -
        ⌈Real.rpow
            (m : ℝ)
            α⁻¹⌉₊) +
      ⌈Real.rpow
          (m : ℝ)
          α⁻¹⌉₊ =
        n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hceil :
      ⌈Real.rpow
          (m : ℝ)
          α⁻¹⌉₊ ≤ n :=
    realDualCeil_le_of_mem_cutoff
      α n m hα hm
  apply Nat.sub_add_cancel
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.realDualInversionSum_add_ceilSum
statement:
theorem realDualInversionSum_add_ceilSum
    (α : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          (realFloorPowerCutoff α n))
        (fun m =>
          n + 1 -
            ⌈Real.rpow
                (m : ℝ)
                α⁻¹⌉₊) +
      realCeilPowerSum
        α⁻¹
        (realFloorPowerCutoff α n) =
      (n + 1) *
        realFloorPowerCutoff α n
proof:
:= by
  unfold realCeilPowerSum
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  calc
    Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc
            1
            (realFloorPowerCutoff α n))
          (fun m =>
            (n + 1 -
                ⌈Real.rpow
                    (m : ℝ)
                    α⁻¹⌉₊) +
              ⌈Real.rpow
                  (m : ℝ)
                  α⁻¹⌉₊) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc
            1
            (realFloorPowerCutoff α n))
          (fun _ => n + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      exact
        realInversionTerm_add_dualCeil
          α n m hα hm
    _ =
        (n + 1) *
          realFloorPowerCutoff α n := by
      simp [Nat.card_Icc, Nat.mul_comm]

name: RoundedRootSums.realPowerReciprocity
statement:
theorem realPowerReciprocity
    (α : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α) :
    realFloorPowerSum α n +
      realCeilPowerSum
        α⁻¹
        (realFloorPowerCutoff α n) =
      (n + 1) *
        realFloorPowerCutoff α n
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    realFloorPowerSum_eq_dualSum
      α n hα
  ]
  exact
    realDualInversionSum_add_ceilSum
      α n hα

name: RoundedRootSums.realPowerReciprocity_explicit
statement:
theorem realPowerReciprocity_explicit
    (α : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc 1 n)
        (fun k =>
          ⌊Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α⌋₊) +
      Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc
          1
          ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α⌋₊)
        (fun m =>
          ⌈Real.rpow
              (m : ℝ)
              α⁻¹⌉₊) =
      (n + 1) *
        ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  simpa [
    realFloorPowerSum,
    realCeilPowerSum,
    realFloorPowerCutoff
  ] using
    realPowerReciprocity
      α n hα

name: RoundedRootSums.realShiftRealInversionMainTheorem
statement:
theorem realShiftRealInversionMainTheorem
    (α θ : ℝ)
    (n : Nat)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k =>
            ⌊Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α + θ⌋₊) =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc
            1
            ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α + θ⌋₊)
          (fun m =>
            n + 1 -
              ⌈Real.rpow
                  ((m : ℝ) - θ)
                  α⁻¹⌉₊)) ∧
      (Finset.sum
            (Finset.Icc 1 n)
            (fun k =>
              ⌊Real.rpow (k : ℝ) α⌋₊) +
          Finset.sum
            (Finset.Icc
              1
              ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α⌋₊)
            (fun m =>
              ⌈Real.rpow
                  (m : ℝ)
                  α⁻¹⌉₊) =
        (n + 1) *
          ⌊Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α⌋₊)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact
      realShiftExactInversion
        α θ n hα hθ
  · exact
      realPowerReciprocity_explicit
        α n hα

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_block (m k : Nat) :
    Nat.sqrt k = m ↔ m ^ 2 ≤ k ∧ k < (m + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    subst m
    constructor
    · simpa [pow_two] using Nat.sqrt_le k
    · have hlt : Nat.sqrt k < Nat.sqrt k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
      exact (Nat.sqrt_lt' (m := k) (n := Nat.sqrt k + 1)).mp hlt
  · intro h
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · have hs : Nat.sqrt k < m + 1 := by
        exact (Nat.sqrt_lt' (m := k) (n := m + 1)).mpr h.2
      omega
    · exact (Nat.le_sqrt).2 (by simpa [pow_two] using h.1)

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_eq_of_mem_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_eq_of_mem_block (m k : Nat)
    (h₁ : m ^ 2 ≤ k)
    (h₂ : k < (m + 1) ^ 2) :
    Nat.sqrt k = m
proof:
:= by
  exact (sqrt_block m k).2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_const_on_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_const_on_block (m t : Nat)
    (h : t < 2 * m + 1) :
    Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + t) = m
proof:
:= by
  apply sqrt_eq_of_mem_block
  · omega
  · nlinarith

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_squareBlock_iff
statement:
theorem mem_squareBlock_iff (m k : Nat) :
    k ∈ squareBlock m ↔
      m ^ 2 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareBlock]

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_const_on_squareBlock
statement:
theorem sqrt_const_on_squareBlock
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t < 2 * m + 1) :
    Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + t) = m
proof:
:= by
  simpa [squareBlock] using sqrt_const_on_block m t ht

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerDenominator_pos

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidue_add_denominator_mul_div
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidue_add_denominator_mul_div

    shiftedPowerResidue q a b m +
        shiftedPowerDenominator q b *
          (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m /
            shiftedPowerDenominator q b) =
      shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedPowerResidue

    (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m)
    (shiftedPowerDenominator q b)

proof:

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdQuotient_eq_div_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdQuotient_eq_div_add_one_iff
    (q a b m : Nat) :
