  · simp [h]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRationalPower_eq_num_div_den
statement:
theorem shiftedRationalPower_eq_num_div_den
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    (((m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) =
      (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m : Rat) /
        (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat)
proof:
:= by
  have hbRat : (b : Rat) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)
  have hbase :
      (m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat) =
        ((b * m - a : Nat) : Rat) / (b : Rat) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub ham, Nat.cast_mul]
    field_simp [hbRat]
  rw [hbase]
  simp [shiftedPowerNumerator, shiftedPowerDenominator,
    div_pow, Nat.cast_sub ham]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_eq_natCeil_num_div_den
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_eq_natCeil_num_div_den
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    shiftedThresholdNat q a b m =
      ⌈(shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m : Rat) /
        (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat)⌉₊
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply
      (shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
        q a b m
          ⌈(shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m : Rat) /
            (shiftedPowerDenominator q b : Rat)⌉₊
          hb ham).mpr
    rw [shiftedRationalPower_eq_num_div_den
      q a b m hb ham]
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  · rw [Nat.ceil_le]
    rw [← shiftedRationalPower_eq_num_div_den
      q a b m hb ham]
    have hInt :
        shiftedThreshold q a b m ≤
          (shiftedThresholdNat q a b m : Int) := by
      rw [shiftedThresholdNat_cast
        q a b m hb ham]
    simpa [shiftedThreshold] using
      (Int.ceil_le.mp hInt)

name: RoundedRootSums.natCeil_natCast_div_natCast_eq_div_add_correction
statement:
theorem natCeil_natCast_div_natCast_eq_div_add_correction
    (N D : Nat)
    (hD : 0 < D) :
    ⌈(N : Rat) / (D : Rat)⌉₊ =
      N / D + if N % D = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  have hD_rat : (0 : Rat) < (D : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hD
  have hdecomp :
      N % D + (N / D) * D = N := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
      (Nat.mod_add_div N D)
  by_cases hrem : N % D = 0
  · rw [if_pos hrem, Nat.add_zero]
    have hmul :
        N = (N / D) * D := by
      omega
    have hD_ne : (D : Rat) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt hD_rat
    have hfrac :
        (N : Rat) / (D : Rat) =
          ((N / D : Nat) : Rat) := by
      apply (div_eq_iff hD_ne).2
      exact_mod_cast hmul
    rw [hfrac]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hrem]
    have hrpos :
        0 < N % D :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hrem
    have hrlt :
        N % D < D :=
      Nat.mod_lt N hD
    have hlower :
        (N / D) * D < N := by
      omega
    have hupper :
        N ≤ (N / D + 1) * D := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
      omega
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Nat.ceil_le]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hD_rat).2
      exact_mod_cast hupper
    · rw [Nat.succ_le_iff]
      rw [Nat.lt_ceil]
      apply (lt_div_iff₀ hD_rat).2
      exact_mod_cast hlower

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_eq_thresholdQuotient
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_eq_thresholdQuotient
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    shiftedThresholdNat q a b m =
      shiftedThresholdQuotient q a b m
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedThresholdNat_eq_natCeil_num_div_den
    q a b m hb ham]
  unfold shiftedThresholdQuotient
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrection
  unfold shiftedPowerResidue
  exact
    natCeil_natCast_div_natCast_eq_div_add_correction
      (shiftedPowerNumerator q a b m)
      (shiftedPowerDenominator q b)
      (shiftedPowerDenominator_pos q b hb)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdSum_eq_quotientSum_add_correctionSum
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdSum_eq_quotientSum_add_correctionSum
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedThresholdSum q a b t =
      shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b t +
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedThresholdSum
  unfold shiftedPowerQuotientSum
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrectionSum
  calc
    Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1)) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedThresholdQuotient q a b (m + 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m _hm
      apply shiftedThresholdNat_eq_thresholdQuotient
      · exact hb
      · calc
          a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
          _ = b * 1 := by simp
          _ ≤ b * (m + 1) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
              (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))
    _ =
        Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
          shiftedPowerNumerator q a b (m + 1) /
            shiftedPowerDenominator q b) +
        Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
          shiftedResidueCorrection q a b (m + 1)) := by
      simp only [shiftedThresholdQuotient]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedSum_residue_formula
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedSum_residue_formula
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
        (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b
            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
          shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
        shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
          shiftedThresholdSum q a b
            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) :=
      shiftedRealRoundedSum_explicit_formula
        q a b n hq hb ha
    _ =
        shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n)) := by
      rw [shiftedThresholdSum_eq_quotientSum_add_correctionSum
        q a b (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) hb ha]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResiduePeriod_mul_base
statement:
theorem shiftedResiduePeriod_mul_base
    (q b : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    shiftedResiduePeriod q b * b =
      shiftedPowerDenominator q b
proof:
:= by
  have h1q : 1 ≤ q :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hq
  have hqSplit :
      q - 1 + 1 = q :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel h1q
  unfold shiftedResiduePeriod
  unfold shiftedPowerDenominator
  calc
    b ^ (q - 1) * b =
        b ^ ((q - 1) + 1) := by
      symm
      exact pow_succ b (q - 1)
    _ = b ^ q := by
      rw [hqSplit]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedPowerResidue_add_period
statement:
theorem shiftedPowerResidue_add_period
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedPowerResidue q a b
        (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) =
      shiftedPowerResidue q a b (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hright :
      a ≤ b * (m + 1) := by
    calc
      a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt ha
      _ = b * 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ b * (m + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))
  have hleft :
      a ≤
        b * (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) := by
    exact le_trans hright
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b
        (Nat.le_add_right
          (m + 1) (shiftedResiduePeriod q b)))
  have hbaseMod :
      b * (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) ≡
        b * (m + 1)
          [MOD shiftedPowerDenominator q b] := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm b (shiftedResiduePeriod q b)]
    rw [shiftedResiduePeriod_mul_base q b hq]
    exact Nat.add_modEq_right
  have hsubMod :
      b * (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) - a ≡
        b * (m + 1) - a
          [MOD shiftedPowerDenominator q b] :=
    Nat.ModEq.sub_right hleft hright hbaseMod
  have hpowMod :
      (b * (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) - a) ^ q ≡
        (b * (m + 1) - a) ^ q
          [MOD shiftedPowerDenominator q b] :=
    Nat.ModEq.pow q hsubMod
  unfold shiftedPowerResidue shiftedPowerNumerator
  exact hpowMod

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrection_add_period
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrection_add_period
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrection q a b
        (m + 1 + shiftedResiduePeriod q b) =
      shiftedResidueCorrection q a b (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrection
  rw [shiftedPowerResidue_add_period
    q a b m hq ha]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrectionAt_add_period
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrectionAt_add_period
    (q a b r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrectionAt q a b
        (shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) =
      shiftedResidueCorrectionAt q a b r
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrectionAt
  simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
    (shiftedResidueCorrection_add_period
      q a b r hq ha)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_period_add
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_period_add
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
        (shiftedResiduePeriod q b + t) =
      shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrectionSum
  unfold shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _hr
  simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
    (shiftedResidueCorrection_add_period
      q a b r hq ha)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_mul_period_add
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_mul_period_add
    (q a b s r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
        (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) =
      s * shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b r
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ s ih =>
      calc
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
            (Nat.succ s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) =
          shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
            (shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r)) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Nat.succ_mul]
            ac_rfl
        _ =
          shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r) :=
          shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_period_add
            q a b
              (s * shiftedResiduePeriod q b + r)
              hq ha
        _ =
          shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
            (s * shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
              shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b r) := by
            rw [ih]
        _ =
          Nat.succ s *
              shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b r := by
            rw [Nat.succ_mul]
            ac_rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_div_mod
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_div_mod
    (q a b t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t =
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
          shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
          (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
          shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
        t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b = t := by
    calc
      (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
            shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
          t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b =
        t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
          shiftedResiduePeriod q b *
            (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) := by
          ac_rfl
      _ = t :=
        Nat.mod_add_div t (shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
  calc
    shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b t =
        shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
          ((t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
              shiftedResiduePeriod q b +
            t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b) := by
      rw [hdecomp]
    _ =
        (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
            shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
          shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
            (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b) :=
      shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_mul_period_add
        q a b
          (t / shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
          (t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b)
          hq ha

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResiduePeriod_pos
statement:
theorem shiftedResiduePeriod_pos
    (q b : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    0 < shiftedResiduePeriod q b
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedResiduePeriod
  exact pow_pos hb (q - 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueRemainder_lt_period
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueRemainder_lt_period
    (q b t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    t % shiftedResiduePeriod q b <
      shiftedResiduePeriod q b
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.mod_lt t
    (shiftedResiduePeriod_pos q b hb)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedRealRoundedSum_periodic_residue_formula
statement:
theorem shiftedRealRoundedSum_periodic_residue_formula
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
      shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
        (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b
            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
          ((shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n /
                shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
              shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n %
                shiftedResiduePeriod q b)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    shiftedRealRoundedSum q a b n =
        shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
            shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n)) :=
      shiftedRealRoundedSum_residue_formula
        q a b n hq hb ha
    _ =
        shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n * (n + 1) -
          (shiftedPowerQuotientSum q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
            ((shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n /
                  shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
                shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
              shiftedResidueCorrectionSum q a b
                (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n %
                  shiftedResiduePeriod q b))) := by
      rw [shiftedResidueCorrectionSum_div_mod
        q a b
          (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n)
          hq ha]

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedResidueCorrection_le_one
statement:
theorem shiftedResidueCorrection_le_one
    (q a b m : Nat) :

        shiftedResidueCorrection q a b (m + 1)) ≤
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun _m => 1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro m _hm

            (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n) +
          ((shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n /
                shiftedResiduePeriod q b) *
              shiftedResidueCorrectionPeriodSum q a b +
            shiftedResiduePeriodicRemainder q a b
              (shiftedRealRoundedValue q a b n)))

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_main_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_main_formula
    (m n : Nat)
    (h₁ : m ^ 2 ≤ n)
    (h₂ : n < (m + 1) ^ 2) :
    rootSum n =
      fullBlocks m +
      lastBlock m n
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero =>
      have hn : n = 0 := by
        omega
      subst n
      simp [rootSum, fullBlocks, lastBlock]
  | succ m =>
      have hsplit :
          (m + 1) ^ 2 - 1 ≤ n := by
        omega
      rw [rootSum_split_at ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1) n hsplit]
      rw [sum_before_square_eq_fullBlocks]
      have hsquare_pos :
          1 ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
        have hm_pos : 1 ≤ m + 1 := by
          omega
        nlinarith
      have hsquare_pred :
          (m + 1) ^ 2 - 1 + 1 =
            (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
        exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hsquare_pos
      have hlength :
          n - ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1) =
            n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hlength]
      have htail :
          Finset.sum
              (Finset.range (n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1))
              (fun k =>
                Nat.sqrt
                  (((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1) + k + 1)) =
            (n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * (m + 1) := by
        calc
          Finset.sum
              (Finset.range (n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1))
              (fun k =>
                Nat.sqrt
                  (((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1) + k + 1))
              =
              Finset.sum
                (Finset.range (n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1))
                (fun _ => m + 1) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro k hk
                  have hklt :
                      k < n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
                    exact Finset.mem_range.mp hk
                  apply sqrt_eq_of_mem_block (m + 1)
                  · omega
                  · omega
          _ = (n - (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * (m + 1) := by
                simp
      rw [htail]
      rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_of_mod_succ_lt
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_of_mod_succ_lt
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hnext :
      t % nearestQExactPeriod q + 1 <
        nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1) =
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t +
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t
proof:
:= by
  have hone :
      1 % nearestQExactPeriod q = 1 := by
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    omega
  have hmod :
      (t + 1) % nearestQExactPeriod q =
        t % nearestQExactPeriod q + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.add_mod, hone]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hnext
  unfold nearestQOmegaTildeAt
  rw [
    hmod,
    Finset.sum_range_succ,
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_mod_eq
      q t hq

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_of_mod_succ_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_of_mod_succ_eq
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hwrap :
      t % nearestQExactPeriod q + 1 =
        nearestQExactPeriod q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1) =
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t +
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv :
      nearestQExactPeriod q ∣ t + 1 := by
    refine
      ⟨t / nearestQExactPeriod q + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [
      Nat.mul_add,
      Nat.mul_one
    ]
    have ht :=
      Nat.mod_add_div
        t
        (nearestQExactPeriod q)
    omega
  have hmod :
      (t + 1) % nearestQExactPeriod q = 0 := by
    exact Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
  have hprefix :
      Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r) +
          nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t =
        0 := by
    calc
      Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r) +
          nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t =
        Finset.sum
            (Finset.range
              (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
            (fun r =>
              nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r) +
          nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q
            (t % nearestQExactPeriod q) := by
              rw [
                nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_mod_eq
                  q t hq
              ]
      _ =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (t % nearestQExactPeriod q + 1))
          (fun r =>
            nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      _ =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.range
            (nearestQExactPeriod q))
          (fun r =>
            nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r) := by
              rw [hwrap]
      _ = 0 :=
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_exactPeriod_sum_zero
          q hq
  unfold nearestQOmegaTildeAt
  rw [hmod]
  simp only [
    Finset.range_zero,
    Finset.sum_empty
  ]
  exact hprefix.symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ
    (q t : Nat)

  · have hwrap :

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_periodic_of_omegaTilde_periodic
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_periodic_of_omegaTilde_periodic
    (q d : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q)
        d) :
    Function.Periodic
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q)
      d
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have hadd :
      t + d + 1 =
        t + 1 + d := by
    omega
  calc
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q (t + d) =
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + d + 1) -
          nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + d) := by
      symm
      exact
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_sub
          q (t + d) hq
    _ =
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1 + d) -
          nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + d) := by
      rw [hadd]
    _ =
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1) -
          nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t := by
      rw [
        hperiod (t + 1),
        hperiod t
      ]
    _ =
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t := by
      exact
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_sub
          q t hq

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
statement:
theorem nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q r =
      1 +
        2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
          nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r
proof:
:= by
  let s : Nat :=
    2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q
  let y : Nat :=
    nearestQPowerResidueAt q r
  have hdPos :
      0 < nearestQResidueStepExponent q :=
    nearestQResidueStepExponent_pos q hq
  have hsOne :
      1 < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    exact
      Nat.one_lt_two_pow
        (Nat.ne_of_gt hdPos)
  have hmod :
      y % s = 1 := by
    have h :=
      nearestQPowerResidueAt_mod_step
        q r hq
    change
      y % s = 1 % s
      at h
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsOne] at h
    exact h
  have hdecomp :
      1 + s * (y / s) = y := by
    have h :=
      Nat.mod_add_div y s
    rw [hmod] at h
    exact h
  unfold nearestQNormalizedResidueAt
  simpa [s, y] using hdecomp.symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_lt_imageSize
statement:
theorem nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_lt_imageSize
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r <
      nearestQResidueImageSize q
proof:
:= by
  rcases
      nearestQPowerResidueAt_exists_predictedParam
        q r hq with
    ⟨j, hj, hjValue⟩
  have hparam :
      1 +
          2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
            nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r =
        1 +
          2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q * j := by
    calc
      1 +
            2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
              nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r =
          nearestQPowerResidueAt q r := by
        symm
        exact
          nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
            q r hq
      _ =
          1 +
            2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q * j := by
        exact hjValue.symm
  have hnormalized :
      nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r = j :=
    nearestQPredictedResidueParam_injective
      q hparam
  rw [hnormalized]
  exact hj

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_periodic
statement:
theorem nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_periodic
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Function.Periodic
      (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q)
      (nearestQExactPeriod q)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiod :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        (nearestQExactPeriod q) :=

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
statement:
theorem nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsLeastPositiveNatPeriod
      (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q)
      (nearestQExactPeriod q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨
    nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hq,
    nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_periodic q hq,
    ?_
  ⟩
  intro d hd hnormalized
  have hresidue :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQPowerResidueAt q)
        d := by
    intro r
    calc
      nearestQPowerResidueAt q (r + d) =
          1 +
            2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
              nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q (r + d) :=
        nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
          q (r + d) hq
      _ =
          1 +
            2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
              nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r := by
        rw [hnormalized r]
      _ =
          nearestQPowerResidueAt q r := by
        symm
        exact
          nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
            q r hq
  exact
    (nearestQPowerResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
      q hq).2.2
      d hd hresidue

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_normalizedFormula
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_normalizedFormula
    (q r : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r =
      ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) -
          1 -
          2 *
            (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat)) /
        (2 *
          (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  have hsizeNe :
      (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.ne_of_gt
        (nearestQResidueImageSize_pos q))
  have hstepNe :
      ((2 : Rat) ^
          nearestQResidueStepExponent q) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  have hproduct :
      ((2 : Rat) ^
            nearestQResidueStepExponent q) *
          (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) =
        (2 : Rat) ^ q :=
    nearestQStepPow_mul_imageSize_cast q
  have hresidue :
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt q r : Rat) =
        1 +
          (2 : Rat) ^
              nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
            (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast
      (nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
        q r hq)
  have hpowSucc :
      (2 : Rat) ^ (q + 1) =
        (2 : Rat) ^ q * 2 := by
    rw [pow_succ]
  unfold
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt
    nearestQOmegaAt
  rw [
    nearestQOmegaExactPeriodMean_eq_closed
      q hq,
    hresidue,
    hpowSucc,
    ← hproduct
  ]
  field_simp [hsizeNe, hstepNe]
  ring

statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_normalizedSum
    (q t : Nat)

      Finset.sum
        (Finset.range
          (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
        (fun r =>
          ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) -
                1 -
                2 *
                  (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat)) /
            (2 *
              (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQOmegaTildeAt
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _hr
  exact
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_normalizedFormula
      q r hq

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNormalizedFormula_sum_eq
statement:
theorem nearestQNormalizedFormula_sum_eq
    (q n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.range n)
        (fun r =>
          ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) -
                1 -
                2 *
                  (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat)) /
            (2 *
              (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat))) =
      (((n : Nat) : Rat) *
            ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) - 1) -
          2 *
            Finset.sum
              (Finset.range n)
              (fun r =>
                (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat))) /
        (2 *
          (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  have hsizeNe :
      (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.ne_of_gt
        (nearestQResidueImageSize_pos q))
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [
        Finset.sum_range_succ,
        Finset.sum_range_succ,
        ih
      ]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hsizeNe]
      ring

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_normalizedPrefixFormula
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_normalizedPrefixFormula
    (q t : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t =
      (((t % nearestQExactPeriod q : Nat) : Rat) *
            ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) - 1) -
          2 *
            Finset.sum
              (Finset.range
                (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
              (fun r =>
                (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat))) /
        (2 *
          (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_normalizedSum
      q t hq,
    nearestQNormalizedFormula_sum_eq
      q
      (t % nearestQExactPeriod q)
  ]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_four
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_four
    (r : Nat) :
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt 4 r = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt
    nearestQOmegaAt
  rw [
    nearestQPowerResidueAt_four,
    nearestQOmegaExactPeriodMean_four
  ]
  norm_num

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_of_exceptional
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_of_exceptional
    (q t : Nat)
    (hExceptional :
      q = 2 ∨ q = 4) :
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hExceptional with hqTwo | hqFour
  · subst q
    simp [nearestQOmegaTildeAt]
  · subst q
    simp [nearestQOmegaTildeAt]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hzero :
      ∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) :
    ∀ t : Nat,
      nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have hdiff :=
    nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_sub
      q t hq
  rw [
    hzero (t + 1),
    hzero t
  ] at hdiff
  simpa using hdiff.symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaAt_periodic_one_of_centered_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaAt_periodic_one_of_centered_eq_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hzero :
      ∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0) :
    Function.Periodic
      (nearestQOmegaAt q)
      1
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have hnext :=
    hzero (t + 1)
  have hcurrent :=
    hzero t
  change
    nearestQOmegaAt q (t + 1) -
        nearestQOmegaExactPeriodMean q =
      0
    at hnext
  change
    nearestQOmegaAt q t -
        nearestQOmegaExactPeriodMean q =
      0
    at hcurrent
  linarith

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hzero :
      ∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) :
    nearestQExactPeriod q = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcentered :
      ∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0 :=
    nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
      q hq hzero
  have homega :
      Function.Periodic
        (nearestQOmegaAt q)
        1 :=
    nearestQOmegaAt_periodic_one_of_centered_eq_zero
      q hcentered
  have hle :
      nearestQExactPeriod q ≤ 1 :=
    (nearestQOmegaAt_isLeastPeriod
      q hq).2.2
      1
      (by norm_num)
      homega
  have hpos :
      0 < nearestQExactPeriod q :=
    nearestQExactPeriod_pos q hq
  omega

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_iff_exceptional
statement:
theorem nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_iff_exceptional
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    nearestQExactPeriod q = 1 ↔
      q = 2 ∨ q = 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hperiod
    by_contra hExceptional
    unfold nearestQExactPeriod at hperiod
    rw [if_neg hExceptional] at hperiod
    by_cases hqOdd :
        Odd q
    · rw [if_pos hqOdd] at hperiod
      rw [nearestQResiduePeriod_eq] at hperiod
      have hexponent :
          0 < q - 1 := by
        omega
      have hpow :
          1 < 2 ^ (q - 1) := by
        exact
          Nat.one_lt_two_pow
            (Nat.ne_of_gt hexponent)
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hqOdd] at hperiod
      have hqEven :
          Even q := by
        obtain ⟨k, hkEven | hkOdd⟩ :=
          Nat.even_or_odd' q
        · exact
            ⟨k, by
              omega⟩
        · exfalso
          apply hqOdd
          exact
            ⟨k, by
              omega⟩
      have hqNeTwo :
          q ≠ 2 := by
        intro h
        apply hExceptional
        exact Or.inl h
      have hqNeFour :
          q ≠ 4 := by
        intro h
        apply hExceptional
        exact Or.inr h
      have hqSix :
          6 ≤ q := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hqEven
        omega
      have hperiodTwo :
          2 ≤ nearestQEvenResiduePeriod q :=
        nearestQEvenResiduePeriod_two_le
          q hqSix hqEven
      omega
  · intro hExceptional
    unfold nearestQExactPeriod
    rw [if_pos hExceptional]

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (∀ t : Nat,
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) ↔
      q = 2 ∨ q = 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    apply
      (nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_iff_exceptional
        q hq).1
    exact
      nearestQExactPeriod_eq_one_of_omegaTilde_eq_zero
        q
        (by omega)
        hzero
  · intro hExceptional t
    exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_of_exceptional
        q t hExceptional

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
statement:
theorem nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (∀ t : Nat,
      nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0) ↔
      q = 2 ∨ q = 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcentered
    apply
      (nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
        q hq).1
    intro t
    unfold nearestQOmegaTildeAt
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _hr
    exact hcentered r
  · intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with hqTwo | hqFour
    · subst q
      intro t
      exact nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_two t
    · subst q
      intro t
      exact nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_four t

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQNormalizedResidueMainTheorem
statement:
theorem nearestQNormalizedResidueMainTheorem
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsLeastPositiveNatPeriod
        (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q)
        (nearestQExactPeriod q) ∧
      (∀ r : Nat,
        nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r <
          nearestQResidueImageSize q) ∧
      (∀ r : Nat,
        nearestQPowerResidueAt q r =
          1 +
            2 ^ nearestQResidueStepExponent q *
              nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r) ∧
      (∀ r : Nat,
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q r =
          ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) -
              1 -
              2 *
                (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat)) /
            (2 *
              (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_isLeastPeriod
        q hq
  · intro r
    exact
      nearestQNormalizedResidueAt_lt_imageSize
        q r hq
  · intro r
    exact
      nearestQPowerResidueAt_eq_one_add_step_mul_normalized
        q r hq
  · intro r
    exact
      nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_normalizedFormula
        q r hq

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_centeredOmega_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_centeredOmega_eq_zero
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (∀ t : Nat,
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) ↔
      (∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) ↔
        q = 2 ∨ q = 4 :=
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
        q hq
    _ ↔
        (∀ t : Nat,
          nearestQCenteredOmegaAt q t = 0) :=
      (nearestQCenteredOmegaAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
        q hq).symm

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestQPeriodicAntiderivativeMainTheorem
statement:
theorem nearestQPeriodicAntiderivativeMainTheorem
    (q : Nat)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    IsLeastPositiveNatPeriod
        (nearestQOmegaTildeAt q)
        (nearestQExactPeriod q) ∧
      (∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q (t + 1) -
            nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t =
          nearestQOmegaAt q t -
            nearestQOmegaExactPeriodMean q) ∧
      (∀ t : Nat,
        nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t =
          (((t % nearestQExactPeriod q : Nat) : Rat) *
                ((nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat) - 1) -
              2 *
                Finset.sum
                  (Finset.range
                    (t % nearestQExactPeriod q))
                  (fun r =>
                    (nearestQNormalizedResidueAt q r : Rat))) /
            (2 *
              (nearestQResidueImageSize q : Rat))) ∧
      ((∀ t : Nat,
          nearestQOmegaTildeAt q t = 0) ↔
        q = 2 ∨ q = 4)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_isLeastPeriod
        q
        (by omega)
  · intro t
    exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_succ_sub_eq_omega_sub_mean
        q t
        (by omega)
  · intro t
    exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_normalizedPrefixFormula
        q t
        (by omega)
  · exact
      nearestQOmegaTildeAt_eq_zero_iff_exceptional
        q hq

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_unfold
statement:
theorem rootSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: RoundedRootSums.blockSum_formula
statement:
theorem blockSum_formula (m : Nat) :
    blockSum m = m * (2 * m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockSum
  calc
    Finset.sum
        (Finset.Icc (m ^ 2) ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1))
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt k)
        =
        Finset.sum
          (Finset.Icc (m ^ 2) ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1))
          (fun _ => m) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hk' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
      apply sqrt_eq_of_mem_block m k
      · exact hk'.1
      · exact Nat.lt_of_le_sub_one (by positivity) hk'.2
    _ =
        (Finset.Icc (m ^ 2) ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1)).card * m := by
      simp
    _ = (2 * m + 1) * m := by
      have hcard :
          (Finset.Icc (m ^ 2) ((m + 1) ^ 2 - 1)).card =
            2 * m + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.card_Icc]
        have hpow :
            (m + 1) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + (2 * m + 1) := by
          ring
        rw [hpow]
        have hpos :
            1 ≤ m ^ 2 + (2 * m + 1) := by
          omega
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos]
        omega
      rw [hcard]
    _ = m * (2 * m + 1) := by
      ring

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_range_split_sub
statement:
theorem sum_range_split_sub
    {α : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : Nat → α)
    (a n : Nat)
    (h : a ≤ n) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) f =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range a) f +
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (n - a))
        (fun k => f (a + k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact Finset.sum_range_add f a b
